jobs.description:
Information Factory steht für Management Consulting, Technologie und datenbasierte Lösungen. Für die Betreuung führender kantonaler Steuerverwaltungen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer etablierten Steuerlösungen suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Kundenbeziehungen, Fachprozesse und Technologie miteinander verbindet.

Deine Mission

Du gestaltest langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden fachlich-technische Roadmaps und sorgst dafür, dass unsere geschäftskritischen Lösungen nachhaltigen Nutzen schaffen. Dabei verbindest du Lösungsdesign, Betrieb, Sicherheit, Organisation und die Perspektive der Fachbereiche.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Wichtige Kundenbeziehungen im kantonalen Steuerumfeld betreuen und weiterentwickeln

  • Client-Success-Pläne mit messbaren Ergebnissen und klaren Review-Punkten entwickeln

  • Kundennutzen, Adoption und Beziehungsqualität steuern und Risiken früh erkennen

  • Fachlich-technische Mehrjahres-Roadmaps mit Fachbereich, IT, Betrieb und Management erarbeiten

  • Bestehende Steuerlösungen und das Lösungsportfolio im Public Sector weiterentwickeln

  • Informationssicherheit, Auditierbarkeit, Business Continuity und hohe Verfügbarkeit einbeziehen

  • Neue Vorhaben identifizieren und Angebote gemeinsam mit dem Account Management entwickeln

Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Delivery

Du verantwortest Kundenbeziehung, Kundenergebnisse, Adoption, gemeinsame Roadmap und Account-Entwicklung. Der Solution Delivery Manager verantwortet Umsetzung, Umfang, Termine, Budget, Qualität, Releases und Betriebsbereitschaft. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für realistische Zusagen und klare Erwartungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Erfahrung oder einen gleichwertigen Leistungsausweis mit komplexen strategischen Kunden

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Verantwortung für ein geschäftskritisches System oder eine vergleichbare Lösungslandschaft im Betrieb

  • Unternehmerisches Urteilsvermögen mit Fokus auf langfristigen Kundennutzen

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, mindestens C1, und Englisch mindestens B2

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Kundenterminen in der Schweiz

Besonders wertvoll

Erfahrung im Schweizer Steuerwesen, in einer kantonalen Verwaltung oder im weiteren Public Sector ist ein starker Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Die Steuerdomäne kann aufgebaut werden. Ebenfalls wertvoll sind Kenntnisse von eGovernment, eCH-Standards, Informationssicherheit, öffentlicher Beschaffung, HERMES oder regulierten Hochverfügbarkeitsumgebungen.

jobs.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role

As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.

  • Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.

  • Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.

  • ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.

  • Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.

  • Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.

  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.

  • Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.

  • Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.

  • Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).

  • Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.

If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

jobs.description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

jobs.title: Endear - Product Designer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Knit - Research Manager
jobs.description:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

Waniwani builds the infrastructure that distributes insurance and banking products through AI assistants. We raised an $8M seed led by Seedcamp and work with large European banks and insurers. Each enterprise deal has to be scoped, architected, and deployed into a regulated environment. This role owns the layer between a signed deal and a live deployment.

The role

  • Customer workshops, discovery, and requirements (35%). Run technical discovery and workshops with each client, and translate their needs into clear, buildable product requirements for our sales, ops, and engineering teams. Flag what we need to build to support a given setup, such as client self-hosting.

  • Solution architecture and documentation (35%). Design the end-to-end MCP flow and integration architecture for each client, including hosted versus on-premise scenarios, and produce the technical documentation enterprise clients require (BPI France alone is roughly 50 docs).

  • Procurement, security, and delivery oversight (30%). Use our existing compliance library (SOC 2 program, DPAs, prior questionnaire answers) to complete security questionnaires, handle security committees and data-residency questions, and drive procurement to completion. Oversee the MCP deployment itself, which our freelancer network implements.

Across all three, you build the reusable kit that makes this repeatable: scoping templates, architecture patterns, and a procurement answer library.

Objectives

  • 90 days: own scoping and procurement response for active deals, with the reusable kit used on at least one live deal end to end.

  • 6 months: run the full signed-to-live pipeline, including architecture decisions and procurement ownership, without founders in the critical path.

  • 12 months: a repeatable delivery process with patterns reused across clients, and a case for the first hire under this role.

Requirements

  • You are technically credible: you read code, reason fluently about integrations and the MCP and agent stack, and can scope and oversee a deployment. This is not a hands-on production-coding role; implementation is handled by our freelancer network.

  • You are comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise clients.

  • You can drive a security questionnaire or procurement process to completion from existing documentation.

  • You have worked in or near regulated industries (finance, insurance) and understand compliance and data residency requirements.

  • You work well in ambiguity across sales, ops, and engineering, and ramp into new domains quickly.

  • You have an interest in the MCP and agent stack.

  • You are open to traveling from time to time across Europe and the US to meet clients.

What this role is not

  • A backend engineering role. You will work with clients most of the week.

  • A pure pre-sales role. You own architecture, requirements, and delivery oversight, not only the pitch.

  • A slideware role. You need real technical depth, even though you are not writing production code day to day.

Practicalities

  • Remote-first, based in Europe. Expect travel roughly once a month, primarily Paris, London, and Madrid, with US travel around the 6-month mark. Being able to come to Paris occasionally is a plus but not required.

  • First hire in this function, working directly with the founders and the engineering team.

Process

  • Intro call with our talent partner.

  • 30-minute conversation with Max, our CTO.

  • Work sample based on a real client scenario (live session): scope the flow, draft the architecture, and handle a mock procurement Q&A.

  • Discussions with Robin, our CEO, Luiza, and members of the tech team.

  • Reference checks.

jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in?

At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field—not just in theory.


Your Role

As Team Lead – AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring prior leadership experience and are ready to lead a team of AI engineers: setting technical direction, growing your team's capabilities, and making sure the team consistently delivers reliable, scalable AI systems.

The Technical ChallengeYour team will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.


Your Mission

  • Lead and long-term grow a team of AI engineers, providing both strategical technical direction and people leadership
  • Own MLOps processes and infrastructure, ensuring our AI systems are reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Drive the design and implementation of advanced AI features, partnering closely with engineering and product leadership to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
  • Set the bar for accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of our AI features through rigorous testing practices
  • Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and drive the build of new ones from scratch
  • Translate customer needs into technical priorities and represent AI engineering in strategic product and sales discussions
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices across the team
  • Coach and develop your team members, supporting their technical and professional growth
  • Champion the use of modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor across the team


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • 5+ years of experience in AI engineering and at least 1+ years in a leading position, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
  • Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, with strong people-leadership skills
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

  • Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
  • Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
  • AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
  • Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.

Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Deine Rolle

Als Account Executive (w/m/d) bei VESTIGAS verantwortest du qualifizierte Leads über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg – von der ersten Präsentation unserer Lösung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Je nach Erfahrung, Dealgröße und Komplexität führst du eigenständig schnelle Abschlüsse oder steuerst anspruchsvollere Sales-Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Sales oder den Foundern.
Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen, berätst lösungsorientiert und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datengetrieben, pflegst Deals und Aktivitäten zuverlässig in HubSpot und nutzt Forecasts sowie KPIs als Grundlage für Transparenz und Planbarkeit.

Die Herausforderung
Unsere Kund:innen entscheiden sehr wirtschaftlich – umso wichtiger ist es, den Nutzen unserer Plattform in klare, nachvollziehbare Zahlen zu übersetzen: weniger manueller Aufwand, weniger rechtliches Risiko, messbare Kostenersparnis. Ein SaaS-Abo folgt dabei einer anderen Logik als eine klassische Investitionsentscheidung, und du hilfst dabei, diesen Mehrwert verständlich zu machen. Weil Dealgröße und Komplexität von Fall zu Fall variieren, wechselst du zwischen schnellem Abschluss und mehrstufigem Prozess – und sorgst trotzdem für verlässliches Forecasting.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst qualifizierte Leads vom BDR-Team und führst passgenaue Demos für unterschiedliche Stakeholder – vom Einkauf bis zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Du managst diese unterschiedlichen Stakeholder über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten eingebunden bleiben und an einem Strang ziehen.
  • Du baust Vertrauen auf, indem du Erfahrungen unserer Referenzkund:innen teilst – darunter 14 der Top-20-Bauunternehmen Deutschlands – da persönliche Beziehungen und Referenzen in der Baubranche besonders viel zählen.
  • Du verhandelst Konditionen und Verträge – eigenständig oder mit dem Head of Sales – und behältst dabei die rechtssichere Dokumentenverarbeitung als zentrales Verkaufsargument im Blick.
  • Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss übergibst du strukturiert an Customer Success, damit der Start für neue Kund:innen reibungslos verläuft.
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools wie Copilot, Claude und Cursor, um Angebote und Präsentationen effizienter vorzubereiten.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb und einen überzeugenden Track Record als Account Executive.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung aus einem Startup- oder Scale-up-Umfeld mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Bereich oder mit Bezug zur Bauindustrie.
  • Du schließt Deals unterschiedlicher Größe selbstständig ab, von schnellen Abschlüssen bis zu anspruchsvollen Projekten.
  • Du arbeitest sehr strukturiert und sauber, nutzt HubSpot oder vergleichbare CRM-Systeme exzellent und überzeugst durch klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch fließend.
  • Du lebst in oder in der Nähe von München und bist bereit, 2-3 Tage pro Woche im Büro präsent zu sein.

jobs.title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Karriere

Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten Softwarelösungen – von der ersten Idee bis in den stabilen Produktivbetrieb
  • Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails
  • Design und Umsetzung von LLM-Anwendungen: RAG-Pipelines, strukturierte Extraktion, Evaluation, Observability
  • Integration von ML-Modellen, Foundation Models und datengetriebenen Services in bestehende oder neue Systeme – inklusive der APIs, Datenflüsse und Infrastruktur drumherum
  • Hands-on-Entwicklung skalierbarer, wartbarer und performanter Anwendungen auf modernen Technologien und Cloud-Plattformen (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry o. ä.)
  • Identifikation von KI-Use-Cases in Kundenprojekten – und die ehrliche Einschätzung, wann ein Agent die richtige Antwort ist und wann eine deterministische Lösung die bessere
  • Agentic Coding im eigenen Arbeitsalltag: KI-Werkzeuge produktiv und verantwortungsvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery einsetzen – und dem Team zeigen, wie es geht
  • Technologische Beratung unserer Kunden bei Architektur-, Technologie- und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen
  • Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität durch Clean Code, Tests, Reviews und Best Practices
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres wachsenden KI-Kompetenzfelds – Themen setzen, Wissen ins Team tragen, Standards etablieren

jobs.title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

jobs.title: Enhetschef till Kulturskolan!
jobs.description:
Vill du leda en verksamhet där kreativitet, kvalitet och utveckling står i fokus och samtidigt bidra till att göra skillnad för barn och unga? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig.

Vi söker en enhetschef till Kulturskolan i Kumla. Kulturskolan är en del av Kulturavdelningen, som även omfattar allmänkultur och folkbiblioteksverksamhet. Samverkan mellan verksamheterna är en viktig framgångsfaktor och bidrar till att vi når och engagerar kommunens olika målgrupper.

Som enhetschef har du din arbetsplats på Kulturskolan, som är belägen i Vialundskolan, en av Kumlas tre högstadieskolor.

Kulturskolan erbjuder barn och unga ett brett utbud inom bland annat musik, dans, teater, bild och cirkus. Verksamheten samverkar med Förvaltning för livslångt lärande inom bland annat Skapande skola samt kulturskoleverksamhet på fritidshem i såväl grundskola som anpassad grundskola.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som enhetschef för Kulturskolan har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhet, ekonomi, 16 medarbetare, arbetsmiljö och lokaler. Du leder, planerar och följer upp verksamheten samt driver utvecklingsarbete för att möta framtidens behov.

Tillsammans med kulturskolans pedagoger arbetar du för att säkerställa en undervisning av hög kvalitet och ett attraktivt kursutbud. Du ansvarar även för att skapa goda förutsättningar för konserter, föreställningar, vernissager och lovaktiviteter som ger barn och unga möjlighet att utvecklas och uttrycka sin kreativitet.

Rollen innebär att du växlar mellan strategiska utvecklingsfrågor och verksamhetens dagliga arbete. Du samverkar nära såväl interna kommunala verksamheter som inom den regionala kulturskolesamverkan och andra samarbetspartners. På uppdrag av Förvaltning för livslångt lärande ansvarar du även för samordningen av Skapande skola.

Som Kulturskolans enhetschef verkar du inom Kultur- och fritidsförvaltningen och ingår i Kulturavdelningens styrgrupp. Där bidrar du till samverkan, utveckling och strategiska frågor som rör Kulturavdelningens samlade verksamhet

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är en trygg och utvecklingsinriktad ledare med förmågan att skapa engagemang och delaktighet. Du bygger tillitsfulla relationer, inspirerar människor att växa och leder med tydlighet och närvaro. Du kombinerar ett strategiskt perspektiv med god organisatorisk förmåga och kan omsätta idéer till konkreta resultat. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och ledarskapsförmåga.

Du verkar för hög kvalitet i undervisningen och driver utvecklingen av kulturskolans kursutbud. Samtidigt värnar du om en kreativ, trygg och inkluderande miljö för såväl elever som medarbetare. Du har ett genuint kulturintresse och en god förståelse för kulturskolans betydelse och uppdrag, både lokalt och i ett bredare samhällsperspektiv.

Du har högskoleexamen inom pedagogik eller kultur, alternativt annan högskoleutbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant och likvärdig, samt några års chefserfarenhet. Vidare har du förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i både tal och i skrift på svenska och har relevant digital kompetens och god vana i att arbeta i Office 365. B-körkort är nödvändigt då du kommer att behöva använda bil i tjänsten.

Meriterande är tidigare chefserfarenhet från kulturskoleverksamhet, erfarenhet av pedagogisk verksamhet eller verksamhet riktad till barn och unga samt erfarenhet av att arbeta i en politiskt styrd organisation.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat som kommer att tillsättas under förutsättning att erforderliga beslut fattas. Det finns goda möjligheter till förlängning.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse, upphör: 2028-06-30  .

Du söker tjänsten via Offentliga jobbs elektroniska ansökningsblankett. Tillsättningen av tjänsten kommer grunda sig på de uppgifter du lämnar och därför är det av största vikt att du är noggrann när du fyller i din ansökan. I din ansökan ska du ange medborgarskap. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du också kunna styrka att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställningen kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter? Kontakta HR-avdelningen direkt på telefon 019-588 000 så hjälper vi dig med en säker ansökan.

Innan anställning ska du visa giltig identitetshandling och i de fall som befattningen kräver det ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi undanber oss kontakt med annonsörer och bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag.

Kumla kommun är en tillväxtkommun som ligger centralt i Örebro län och har drygt 22 600 invånare. I kommunen finns framgångsrika företag, ett rikt kultur- och fritidsutbud, god kommunal service samt utmärkta kommunikationer. Kumlas Vision 2040 innebär Kumla är en trygg, familjevänlig plats där människor känner en samhörighet och ett sammanhang. Den blomstrande och gröna småstaden har bostäder, men även de jobb, den service och det utbud som behövs för en komplett vardag.

jobs.title: Ressurspedagog- Vil du bidra til at alle barn får oppleve tilhørighet, lek, utvikling og mestring?
jobs.description:
Vi søker en engasjert og faglig trygg ressurspedagog som skal arbeide på tvers
av våre tre barnehager og 14 avdelinger.

Austsiå barnehagene består av Øygard barnehage, Gravarslia barnehage og Vatne barnehage – tre
barnehager med fokus på kvalitet, utvikling og gode relasjoner. Hos oss blir du en del av et engasjert fagmiljø
med en styrer i hver barnehage og en felles virksomhetsleder som sammen jobber for å skape den beste hverdagen
for barna. Vi deltar i Sandnes kommunes utviklingsarbeid «Utviklingsstøttende barnehager» (USB), hvor
kompetanseheving og kvalitet står sentralt. Vi jobber for et godt inkluderende miljø for alle barn.

Vi ønsker en medarbeider som brenner for inkluderende praksis, og som ønsker å bidra til at barn med ulike 
forutsetninger får være en naturlig del av fellesskapet.
Som ressurspedagog vil du være en tverrgående fagressurs i virksomheten. Du vil arbeide tett sammen med
pedagogiske ledere og øvrig personale for å utvikle gode, inkluderende miljøer for alle barn.
En viktig del av stillingen vil være å styrke personalets kompetanse og praksis.
Du vil blant annet arbeide med observasjon, veiledning, tiltak, kompetanseutvikling og samarbeid rundt barn og barnegrupper.

Vi ønsker å utvikle en praksis der flest mulig barn opplever:
«Jeg hører til. Jeg får delta. Jeg blir sett. Jeg får være meg selv.»
Som ressurspedagog blir du en viktig ressurs i dette arbeidet.

Stillingen som ressurspedagog er forbeholdt finansiering. Dersom finansiering avsluttes, vil du gå inn i annen stilling i virksomheten.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Observere barn, barnegrupper, lek, samspill og voksenrollen
  • Veilede pedagogiske ledere og øvrig personale
  • Bidra til å identifisere hva som fremmer og hemmer barns deltakelse
  • Bidra med tiltak knyttet til lek, språk, relasjoner, sosial utvikling og inkludering
  • Følge opp og evaluere tiltak
  • Bidra til utvikling av inkluderende pedagogisk praksis
  • Delta i virksomhetens ressursgruppe
  • Delta i møter med foresatte og samarbeidspartnere ved behov
  • Samarbeide med PPT og andre relevante tjenester
  • Bidra til kompetanseutvikling i virksomheten
  • Bidra til å utvikle gode rutiner og systemer for inkluderende praksis
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent pedagogisk utdanning som barnehagelærer, spesialpedagog , barnevernspedagog eller annen relevant bachleor som for
    eksempel vernepleier, sosionom.   (personer med utdanning fra utlandet må legge ved dokumentasjon på at utdanningen er godkjent i Norge)
  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest er en forutsetning for ansettelse. Denne skal ikke legges ved søknaden, men leveres snarest etter tilbud om
    ansettelse og før tiltredelse
  • I denne stillingen kreves det at du leverer egenerklæring for tuberkulose før tiltredelse
  • Erfaring fra barnehage, og med spesialpedagogikk, veiledning, barnehageutvikling eller tverrfaglig samarbeid er ønskelig

Legg ved attester og vitnemål i søknaden (lastes inn som vedlegg i Webcruiter.


Personlige egenskaper
  • Har interesse for og gjerne erfaring med inkluderende praksis
  • Har god relasjonskompetanse
  • Kan observere, analysere og se sammenhenger mellom barnets behov og miljøet rundt barnet
  • Er trygg på å veilede andre
  • Evner å skape tillit og gode samarbeidsrelasjoner
  • Er løsningsorientert og opptatt av praksisnær utvikling
  • Kan arbeide selvstendig og strukturert
  • Er nysgjerrig, reflektert og faglig engasjert
  • Peronlig egnethet vektlegges
Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende og variert stilling på tvers av tre barnehager

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.


What we're looking for

We're looking for an ambitious and talented Director of Engineering to join Omnea, the UK's #1 Startup in 2026, as a senior member of our Engineering leadership team. You'll report directly to our CTO, Dhruv Kumar, who joined us from Voy and has scaled engineering organizations at Hopin, Charlotte Tilbury, and THG.

 

This is a manager-of-managers role. You'll lead a group of Engineering Managers and Team Leads: 25-50 engineers across several teams. You'll own the outcomes, org design, and technical direction of a significant slice of the product.

 

As we grow from tens to hundreds of enterprise customers and through 10x revenue growth in the next 2-3 years, you'll play a crucial role in building the best Engineering function in its category. You'll operate with high autonomy, partnering with the CTO, Product leadership, and your peers across R&D to turn strategy into shipped software.

 

What you’ll do

Build and lead the leaders:

  • Hire, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and Team Leads. Your primary output is their effectiveness, not your own.

  • Set and hold a high performance bar across the group, including the harder calls on performance and leveling.

  • Own org design for your area: how teams are shaped, sized, and split as the product and company grow.

  • Build the bench: identify and grow the next generation of engineering leaders at Omnea.

  • Own the headcount plan for your group, from business case through to hiring.

 

Own delivery at group scale:

  • Be accountable for the outcomes of several teams at once, not the output of any one of them.

  • Create the operating rhythm (planning, prioritization, and reporting) that keeps a multi-team group moving quickly and predictably.

  • Unblock at the seams: the cross-team dependencies, ambiguous ownership, and architectural decisions that no single team can resolve.

  • Ensure robust monitoring, observability, and incident response across your area.

 

Shape technical and product strategy:

  • Partner with the CTO and Product leadership to define and execute the technical roadmap for your domain.

  • Make the build/buy, architecture, and technical investment calls that shape the platform for years, and bring the rest of R&D with you.

  • Balance technical debt, feature development, and reliability, and be able to defend those trade-offs to the exec team.

  • Ensure customer feedback drives technical priorities, including direct time with enterprise customers.

 

Teams and products you might end up working on:

  • Accounting and Goods Receipting – ensuring procurement and finance teams have the right information and tools to operate accurately, automatically, and at scale.

  • Insights and Reporting – deep, complex custom visualizations bringing together AI and data to surface meaningful insights and context across the platform.

  • Sourcing – building the tools that find the right suppliers, shape the right deals, and make sure the best option is already in play before a request is even created.

  • Workflow Orchestration – the configurable backbone of our systems that accurately model company operations, underpinning a single source of truth.

  • And many more areas we’re actively starting or expanding upon!

 

About You

Leadership Experience:

  • You have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in engineering leadership.

  • You have 2+ years managing managers, having hired, coached, and where necessary, performance-managed Engineering Managers or Team Leads.

  • You've led a group of 25-50 engineers across multiple teams and owned the org design for it.

  • You've demonstrated success in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, particularly in rapid-growth periods.

  • Ideally, you've done this at more than one company, including at least one successful Series A+ B2B SaaS company.

 

Technical Excellence:

  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in modern web technologies.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture (preferably AWS), and scalability challenges.

  • Experience with our stack (TypeScript, React, AWS Serverless) is a plus, but not required.

 

Track Record of Impact:

  • Strong track record of delivering complex, multi-team programs that moved company outcomes: product adoption, revenue, and customer retention.

  • Proven history of improving team velocity and quality at the group level, not just within a single team.

  • Experience scaling an engineering organization through a period of rapid growth and adapting the structure as it grew.

  • Experience implementing engineering processes that scale effectively at pace.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and translating their needs into technical solutions.

 

Leadership Style:

  • You're data-driven but know when to trust intuition.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and owning them when they don't land.

  • You excel at influence without authority, across Product, Design, GTM, and the exec team.

  • You have a track record of growing and developing engineering leaders, as well as engineers at all levels (Senior, Staff, Principal).

  • You stay close enough to the technology to be credible with senior engineers without taking the work off them.

 

Nice to haves that really stand out to us:

  • Track record of successful product launches in B2B SaaS.

  • Experience with procurement/finance systems.

  • History of contributions to engineering communities.

 

You can learn more about Engineering at Omnea and our hiring process via our R&D Candidate Hub here.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

  • Coordinate business continuity: BCP/DR obligations and ownership of the Major Incident process, including testing and evidencing

  • Support our AI governance work — our internal AI and engineering AI policies — and help us keep pace with a fast-moving regulatory backdrop (including the EU AI Act), covering data handling, human oversight and vendor assessment

  • Coordinate health & safety compliance as we expand into physical premises and data centre operations, helping build a proper H&S management system where none currently exists

  • Partner closely with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, particularly on KYC, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) evidence, and technical control documentation

  • Help benchmark and align our Code of Conduct and policies with Brookfield's

  • Contribute to the wider roadmap as our footprint grows: precious and conflict-minerals due diligence, export controls, and ESG/energy governance

What You'll Bring

  • Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

  • Genuine curiosity about how controls actually work — you're not satisfied when "the box is ticked," you want to understand the journey behind it

  • Hyper-organised — you can run multiple concurrent workstreams (audits, questionnaires, training, policy updates) without anything slipping

  • A builder's mindset — comfortable creating and automating a process from nothing, not just following an existing playbook

  • Autonomous and idea-driven — you'll be directed on priorities, not micromanaged on approach

  • Mid-level compliance/GRC/information security experience — your background does not need to be from AI infrastructure, data centres, or a related industry

  • Confident stakeholder management — you'll work directly with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, not just within a compliance team

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycles

  • Exposure to business continuity or major incident processes

  • Familiarity with AI governance or emerging AI regulation

  • Interest in health & safety, environmental/ESG reporting, or physical security and facilities governance

  • Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or equivalent)

Why Join Radiant?

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Real ownership of a function you're building from the ground up, with senior support rather than senior oversight

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry, at the intersection of power, compute and capital

  • Backed by Brookfield — genuine resources, mentorship, and room to grow the role as the company scales

jobs.title: Specialistläkare i psykiatri sökes för ADHD-utredningar
jobs.description:
Vi söker en specialistläkare i psykiatri för ett långsiktigt och flexibelt samarbete inom vår verksamhet i centrala Stockholm.

Verksamheten kommer att erbjuda ADHD-utredningar för vuxna, samt medicinsk behandling och uppföljning efter genomförd utredning.

Uppdraget har inga fasta arbetstider eller krav på viss omfattning i början.  Arbetet sker utifrån patientbehov och kan kombineras med annan anställning eller egen verksamhet.

Uppdraget kan bland annat omfatta:

    Psykiatrisk och medicinsk bedömning som del av ADHD-utredning
    Diagnostisk bedömning i samarbete med legitimerad psykolog
    Differentialdiagnostiska bedömningar
    Ställningstagande till läkemedelsbehandling
    Insättning och förskrivning av ADHD-läkemedel
    Stöd till sjuksköterskor vid dosjustering
    Receptförnyelse och medicinsk uppföljning
    Digitala konsultationer samt fysiska besök på mottagning vid behov
    Samarbete med psykolog och sjuksköterska kring patientens fortsatta behandling

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad läkare med specialistkompetens i psykiatri och svensk förskrivningsrätt. Erfarenhet av vuxen-ADHD, neuropsykiatriska utredningar och farmakologisk ADHD-behandling är meriterande.

Vi söker framför allt en läkare som är intresserad av ett långsiktigt samarbete, men där arbetets omfattning kan variera över tid beroende på patientflödet.

Uppdragsform: Konsultuppdrag eller enligt överenskommelse

Omfattning: Vid behov

Plats: Digitalt samt mottagning i centrala Stockholm

Ersättning: Enligt överenskommelse

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Skicka CV och en kort presentation med information om din specialistkompetens, erfarenhet av ADHD-utredningar och behandling samt din tillgänglighet.

jobs.title: Hoofdmekanieker - Hansea Turnhout
jobs.description:
// Functie-inhoud
  • Je hebt uitgebreide kennis van diagnose- en herstellingsprocedures, vooral met betrekking tot elektrische voertuigen.
  • Minstens 10 jaar ervaring in onderhoud en diagnose van voertuigen, bij voorkeur bussen of vrachtwagens.
  • Je beschikt over diepgaande kennis van elektriciteit en mechanica.
  • Je deelt je kennis en ervaring op een toegankelijke manier en weet anderen te motiveren.
  • Je bent oplossingsgericht en sterk in organiseren, met oog voor prioriteiten en efficiÃ«ntie.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands; basiskennis van Frans en Engels is een pluspunt.
  • In het bezit van een rijbewijs D of bereid om dit te behalen.
  • Je bent vaardig in MS Office en hecht veel belang aan veiligheid en netheid.
// Taken

Als Hoofd van onze afdeling Mechaniek ben je verantwoordelijk voor de planning van uit te voeren onderhoud en herstellingen aan de vloot van elektrische en dieselbussen.

  • Je maakt de dagelijkse werkverdeling op.
  • Je bent zelf ook actief in de diagnose van elektrische problemen bij onze bussen.
  • Bij grote problemen aan elektrische bussen sta je zelf in voor de reparatie. Je installeert ook track and trace systemen op bussen.
  • Je geeft intern door welke wisselstukken besteld dienen te worden.
  • Je fungeert als technisch aanspreekpunt binnen je afdeling en deelt je kennis en ervaring met je teamleden.
  • Je bent enthousiast om mee te evolueren naar groene mobiliteit. Je bent een expert in diagnose en houdt je kennis up-to-date.
  • Het werk efficiënt verdelen binnen het team, rekening houdend met (commerciële) prioriteiten en de sterktes van elk teamlid. Controle van de uitgevoerde werken en eventuele bijsturing.
  • Actief meewerken en diagnoses stellen vanuit de rol van expert in mechaniek:
  • Diagnose van bussen: het vaststellen van elektrische problemen en toewijzen van het elektrisch werk;
  • Indien nodig, ondersteuning bieden bij de diagnose van mechanische problemen.
  • De mekaniekers in je team op technisch vlak met raad en daad bijstaan.
  • Herstellingen uitvoeren bij grote problemen aan elektrische bussen. Indien nodig, de elektronische schema's opvragen bij de constructeur zodat het werk correct uitgevoerd kan worden.
  • Intern melden van specifieke problemen of dure herstellingen: indien nodig, overleggen met de leidinggevende.
  • Overbrengen van eigen kennis en ervaring naar de mekaniekers, steeds met de nodige klemtoon op het naleven van milieu- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.
  • Instaan voor het borgen en uitdragen van de opgebouwde kennis en goede praktijken (bijvoorbeeld documenteren van werkwijzen, zoeken naar mogelijke optimalisaties...).
  • Leidinggeven aan een team van een 12-tal garagemedewerkers.
  • Vlot samenwerken met de administratieve medewerkers in de werkplaats, aankoop, constructeurs
  • Zorgen voor een respectvolle en vlotte communicatie van en met chauffeurs in het kader van herstellingen
  • Rapporteren aan de algemeen directeur
  • Je hebt kennis van diagnosetechniek.
  • Je kan minstens 10 jaar ervaring in onderhoud en diagnose van voertuigen voorleggen, bij voorkeur bus of vrachtwagen.
  • Je beschikt over een goede kennis elektriciteit en mechanica.
  • Je deelt je kennis en ervaring op een toegankelijke manier.
  • Je communiceert vlot en kan een team motiveren om het beste van zichzelf te geven.
  • Je bent organisatorisch sterk en denkt in oplossingen.
  • Je drukt je vlot uit in het Nederlands. Een basis Frans en Engels zijn mooi meegenomen.
  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs D of bent bereid dit te behalen.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van MS Office.
  • Je hecht veel belang aan netheid en veiligheid

jobs.description:

  • Je bent sterk in probleemoplossend denken en speelt flexibel in op onverwachte herstellingen.

jobs.title: Busmechanieker - Herentals
jobs.description:
// Functie-inhoud

Als busmechanieker bij Hansea ben je verantwoordelijk voor het preventief en curatief onderhoud van een diverse busvloot, gaande van minibussen tot gelede en elektrische voertuigen. Je draagt bij aan de veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid en duurzaamheid van het dagelijks personenvervoer door technisch vakmanschap en samenwerking binnen een lokaal team van techniekers, chauffeurs en planners.

// Taken
  • Je staat samen met je team in voor het dagelijkse onderhoud en reparaties. Van minibussen tot gelede bussen van 18m lang, elektrisch aangedreven of met diesel. 
  • Je kijkt onze bussen geregeld na zodat je pannes zo veel mogelijk helpt te voorkomen.
  • Is er toch een storing of defect? Dan zoek je naar de oorzaak en lost het snel en efficiënt op.
  • Is de herstelling te groot of specifiek? Dan overleg je met je manager welke je uitbesteedt.
  • Je voert ook depannages uit. Heb je nog geen rijbewijs D? Dan helpen we je graag op weg.
  • Je helpt je collega's van administratie door ook je papierwerk in orde te houden.
  • Je hebt een doorgedreven kennis van automechanica en elektriciteit.
  • Je bent handig met diagnose-apparatuur, kabels, perslucht, airco, ...
  • Je spreekt behoorlijk Nederlands of Engels en hebt een basiskennis van IT.
  • Je hebt een HEV-2 certificaat of ziet het zitten om dat te halen.
  • Je bent bereid om nacht- of weekendwerk te doen (premies).

jobs.description:
// Functie-inhoud

Je zorgt voor een vlotte maand- en jaarafsluiting, ondersteunt bij audits en fiscale verplichtingen, en werkt actief mee aan het stroomlijnen en verbeteren van financiële processen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met andere afdelingen binnen de groep.

  • Je verzorgt de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor een aantal bedrijven binnen onze groep.
  • Je boekt correct op de GL-rekeningen en zorgt voor een accurate verwerking van financiële gegevens.
  • Je bereidt audits, afschrijvingen en betalingen tijdig voor.
  • Je beheert en verwerkt de btw-aangiftes.
  • Je volgt intercompanytransacties en -reconciliaties nauwgezet op.
  • Je fungeert als back-up voor collega's bij ziekte of vakantie.
  • Je boekt verkoopfacturen in voor alle diensten.
  • Je stuurt de goedkeuring van aankoopfacturen in Basware, en zorgt voor een correcte boekhoudkundige verwerking.
  • Je hebt reeds 5 jaar ervaring als GL accountant. 
  • Je hebt ervaring met ERP-systemen zoals SAP, Oracle of Exact, en je bent vertrouwd met MS Office, Excel en AS400.
  • Je hebt kennis van BE GAAP en de Belgische fiscale wetgeving.
  • Je beschikt over een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands.
  • Je werkt analytisch, nauwkeurig en met een sterk oog voor detail.
  • Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt proactief en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je taken.
  • Je bent een teamspeler die energie haalt uit samenwerking binnen het team en met andere afdelingen.
