jobs.title: Product Owner - Core Automation
jobs.description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  


As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job

The Incubator within Alfa Laval's Core Automation organization explores new platforms, technologies and development initiatives that shape the future of Alfa Laval's control systems offering. As Product Owner, you will turn the technology roadmap into coordinated, meaningful deliveries, from early research into new toolkits, platforms and technologies to development initiatives that will serve as the foundation for next-generation control system applications.



Working at the intersection of the Technology Manager, stakeholders and development teams, you will create clarity, align priorities and help the team move forward without unnecessary obstacles. You will translate complex needs into well-defined work items, guide initiatives across the OT platform portfolio and ensure that users, customers and their everyday challenges remain central throughout the design and development process.



Key responsibilities:

    Deliver initiatives supporting the direction in the technology roadmap for the initiatives' relevant stakeholders.

    Refine work items and translate stakeholder needs into clear user stories and backlog items.

    Maintain and prioritize the development backlog in line with agreed commitments for development, rollouts and support.

    Align stakeholders and product groups across the OT platform portfolio.

    Prepare teams for incremental deliveries by clarifying scope, setting objectives and supporting demos.

    Bring contributors together, facilitate alignment and create momentum across initiatives.

    Collaborate with the Agile Team Coach and Focus Manager to improve team performance and share effective ways of working.

    Drive product, technology and platform evaluation initiatives.



Who are you

You are passionate about turning complex needs into contemporary solutions that provide an excellent user experience. You create clarity by listening carefully, structuring information and communicating in a way that helps stakeholders and technical teams understand one another. You are comfortable orchestrating several perspectives, aligning people around priorities and keeping initiatives moving without imposing unnecessary processes. With strong business acumen, analytical thinking and a customer-centric mindset, you are also able to build trusted relationships across teams, departments and organizations.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you combine practical Agile experience with an understanding of product management and complex operational technology environments.

    2-4 years of experience as a Product Owner or Scrum Master.

    Solid understanding of product management and complex OT solutions.

    Strong knowledge of Agile development methodologies.

    Experience working with product roadmaps, backlog prioritization and user stories.

    Experience aligning stakeholders and development teams around shared objectives.

    Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, data science or equivalent experience.

    Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

    Knowledge of control systems, embedded software or electrical design deliveries is appreciated but not required.



What's in It for You?

You will join a highly motivated team working with the latest OT technologies while developing solutions that have not been built before. This is an opportunity to influence Alfa Laval's future automation offering, work across technology and product domains, and help transform early ideas and research initiatives into solutions that create value for our customers and users.



We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.

We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Please send your application no later than October 4th, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!

At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund or Flemingsberg, or have an established presence in the area.

As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.

jobs.title: Global Regulatory & Public Affairs Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to: R&D Sustainability, Compliance and Quality Manager.

As Global Regulatory & Public Affairs Specialist, you will drive regulatory intelligence, stakeholder engagement, and advocacy activities that support compliance, business continuity, and growth. In this highly visible role, you will monitor regulatory developments, assess business impacts, and help shape strategies that align global regulatory requirements with ABB's business objectives.

Our division, IEC LV Motors, holds a market‑leading position by delivering exceptional customer value in efficiency, reliability, and safety - the attributes most valued by our customers and partners. Our strength lies in deep domain expertise and a strong global presence, combined with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, quality, reliability, and safety. Our commitment is to empower our customers with innovative solutions that drive productivity and enhance energy efficiency through our unmatched application expertise and technology leadership, delivering tailored solutions and a first-class customer experience.  The outcome of your work will have a direct impact on our division.

You will work closely with colleagues across R&D, Product Management, Sustainability, Trade Compliance and Supply Chain, while also representing ABB in industry associations, technical forums, and discussions with policymakers and regulatory stakeholders. Your work will contribute to positioning ABB as a trusted voice and thought leader in key regulatory and standards-related topics.

Main Responsibilities

    Collaborate across multiple functions to provide regulatory guidance and support product, technology, and business decisions.

The position is based in Sweden (Vasteras), Finland (Vaasa) or Germany (Mannheim). We offer a hybrid working model; however, the role requires regular on-site presence at the local office.

Qualifications

    Proven ability to influence and collaborate across functions and with external stakeholders, including industry associations, government agencies, and policymakers.

    Degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Political Science, International Studies, or another relevant discipline.

More about us

The IEC Low Voltage Motors division is a technology leader, offering a complete portfolio of IEC low‑voltage motors, from standard to highly specialized solutions, including ultra-efficient solutions such as IE5 SynRM (synchronous reluctance motors). Through a global production footprint in Finland, India and China, domain expertise and rugged designs, the Division provides reliable technology that improves efficiency and productivity even in the most demanding applications.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineering Leader
jobs.description:
Hej QA Engineering Leader,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our QA Engineering Leader, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.



Your new job

We’re looking for a QA Engineering Leader who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading and continuously refining the quality and test automation approach within Range experience together with the other Software Engineering Leaders and Specialists.  

You will also be sharing your work in the wider Range Areas and you’ll report to the Quality Platform QA Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world.

On a typical day, you will:

    Develop QA test plans and define acceptance criteria for both built and purchased software solutions.  
    Plan, coordinate, and lead QA activities to ensure testing is executed effectively and delivered on time.  
    Coach and mentor members of digital product teams on QA frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.  
    Drive clarity, consistency, and quality in requirements across product and platform teams.  
    Champion test data creation, mocking, and test automation as the preferred testing approach, always balancing cost, value, and efficiency.  
    Provide coaching and constructive feedback to engineering and platform communities to strengthen quality practices and a quality-first mindset.  
    Collaborate closely with engineering and platform leaders to ensure features are implemented with quality assurance built into the delivery process.  
    Support product and platform teams in working in a decoupled way to improve software quality and enable effective interface-level testing.  
    Act as the subject matter expert on specialist QA disciplines such as performance testing, penetration testing, and high-availability assurance when needed.  
    Support Engineering Managers in follow-ups, reviews, and quality discussions with consultancy partners.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a person you see the joy of sharing your knowledge and experience with your colleagues across different teams. Being curious and innovative is at the core of everything you do, and you know that making mistakes sometimes is part of your own development and learning journey.

You bring extensive experience and knowledge in software development and are fully familiar with agile/DevOps practices and tooling, and how the quality aspect is an integrated part of the development. Ideally, you have experience in building test automation frameworks and building their usage in an organization of cross-functional product teams.

You are an experienced leader with the ability to coach our product teams, testers and developers alike around test automation as an integrated part in software development, helping to ensure that we use our resources in the best way to achieve the strongest outcome.

You enjoy an agile, iterative and structured way of working and achieving results together with a team in a flexible environment but also have a strong individual drive to deliver high-quality results on time. You have great communication and networking skills and are fluent in written and spoken English.

The role as a QA Engineering Leader requires you to:

    Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.  
    Have at least 2 years of hands-on software engineering experience.  
    Have at least 5 years of hands-on experience working with QA processes, testing methodologies, and QA tooling.  
    Demonstrate strong knowledge of modern digital product development principles, including aligned autonomy, Conway’s Law, product decomposition, DevOps, automation, blue-green deployments, and automated regression testing.  
    Coach and support engineering teams in adopting quality-first ways of working and embedding quality throughout the development lifecycle.  
    Advocate for early defect prevention through practices such as automation, clear requirements, and decoupled architectures.  
    Communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels, both verbally and in writing.  
    Be a trusted subject matter expert in quality assurance, providing guidance on specialist QA approaches when needed.  
    Have experience of building and maintaining modern test automation frameworks for web using Playwright, Cypress or similar, including custom framework design in JavaScript/TypeScript with deep CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions

It’s a plus if you also have experience with:

    Using Sentry, Splunk or similar tools for monitoring and real-time error tracking
    Procurement processes and quality assurance of off-the-shelf or SaaS solutions.  
    Non-functional requirement (NFR) quality assurance and performance testing practices.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 8th of October.

This is a full-time position located in Malmö (Hyllie). We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com.

This position is based in the QA Platform of Inter IKEA Range Operations. Business platforms are new at Range and will support products to be more efficient.

For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.

jobs.title: Frederik på 8 år i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
jobs.description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Senior Projektledare
jobs.description:
Om Multiply & VisFlow

Multiply är ett teknikdrivet end to end solution provider som verkar i gränslandet mellan avancerad mjukvaruutveckling, systemdesign och datadrivna plattformar. Tillsammans med VisFlow – vår egen produkt för strukturerad, visuell och spårbar teknisk kunskap – hjälper vi organisationer att bygga, driva och vidareutveckla komplexa system inom säkerhetskritiska och dataintensiva domäner.

VisFlow omvandlar komplexa tekniska processer, systemflöden och operativ kunskap till tydliga, visuella och sammanlänkade representationer. Plattformen gör det möjligt för team att förstå, förvalta och skala avancerade system genom hela livscykeln – från utveckling och införande till drift och kontinuerlig förbättring.

Rollen

Multiply är ett teknikdrivet konsultbolag som verkar i gränslandet mellan avancerad systemutveckling, mjukvara och komplexa industriella miljöer. Vi arbetar med uppdrag där struktur, tillit och genomförandekraft är avgörande – ofta i säkerhetskritiska sammanhang.

Vi söker nu en Senior Projektledare för uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin, där du får ett tydligt mandat och ett stort ansvar att leda komplexa projekt från start till mål.

Om rollen

Som senior projektledare ansvarar du för helheten i projektleveransen. Du leder och samordnar projektteam, skapar tydlig struktur och säkerställer framdrift i alla projektets faser – från initiering till avslut. Rollen kräver stark kommunikativ förmåga, hög integritet och vana att arbeta nära både styrgrupp och operativa team.

Ansvarsområden

    Leda och samordna projektteam i komplexa miljöer
    Engagera och inspirera team mot gemensamma mål
    Planera, organisera och följa upp projektets samtliga faser
    Rapportera tydlig och korrekt status till styrgrupp och intressenter
    Kommunicera effektivt med interna och externa parter
    Säkerställa rätt förutsättningar och arbeta proaktivt med hinder
    Identifiera, mitigera och rapportera risker
    Dokumentera och strukturera beslut, åtgärder och lärdomar
    Bygga starka relationer och långsiktigt förtroende
    Leda styrgruppsmöten och säkerställa rätt stöd vid rätt tid

Kvalifikationer

    Minst 10 års erfarenhet i ledande roller, varav flera år som projektledare
    Dokumenterad erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin
    God förståelse för arbete i säkerhetsklassade miljöer
    Godkänd säkerhetsprövning (krav)
    Mycket god förmåga att skapa struktur, driva beslut och leverera resultat

Varför Multiply & VisFlow?

Hos Multiply blir du del av en end-to-end-leverantör där djup teknisk kompetens, systemtänkande och långsiktigt värdeskapande står i centrum. I kombination med VisFlow erbjuder vi inte bara projekt, utan ett produkt- och kunskapsekosystem som hjälper organisationer att förstå och förbättra komplexa system över tid.

Denna roll innebär spännande perspektiv och betyder att du kommer jobba med:

    Tekniskt djup – inte förvaltning
    Långsiktighet och stabilitet
    Arbete med system som har direkt betydelse för nationell säkerhet
    En miljö där erfarenhet, struktur och ingenjörsmässighet värderas högt

Hos Multiply arbetar du i sammanhang där systemförståelse, tekniskt ledarskap och långsiktigt tänkande verkligen spelar roll, tillsammans med mycket erfarna ingenjörer i krävande och meningsfulla tekniska miljöer.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Office
jobs.description:
Take AI from the frontier into the field.

The AI Office is a small team with a direct mandate from the CEO to make Bittium an AI-native company. We build the AI tools and infrastructure Bittium works with, and work inside our business segments to bring AI into their products.

We are hiring two new Members of Technical Staff to join the AI Office and work side by side with our Head of AI. What you build ends up in your colleagues' daily work and in products depended on by defence forces, public authorities and healthcare professionals.

You might be the person who

- has rewritten their own agent harness more than once.
- shipped a full app in a weekend for a team that wasn't yours, and they still use it.
- fine-tuned a model and knows whether the eval moving meant anything.
- had a new open-weights model running on their own hardware the day it came out, and had an opinion about it by lunch.
- was pushed by API pricing, or dreams of personal AI sovereignty, into squeezing a model onto hardware it had no business running on.
- has broken a guardrail, and knows why you never rely on just one.
- daydreams of dark software factories.

What you will do

We shape the role around the person, and we make room for exceptional people. If your strength isn't listed below, tell us.

- Keep us ahead. You live and breathe the AI takeoff: the models, the hardware, the tools and where the whole industry is heading. Separate what matters from the noise early, and steer where we put our effort.
- Go where the work is. Sit with legal, finance, sales, R&D or production, find the work AI should be doing, and build it fast.
- Run and grow our AI infrastructure and applications. Inference on our own GPUs, the services on top of it and the end-user applications people work with every day. When a new model is worth having, it is live the same week.
- Build the AI our products run on. Build and maintain the agent harnesses, models and safeguards our business segments build products on, and keep them working all the way out to battlefield conditions.
- Make models ours. Post-train open-weights models until they beat the general-purpose ones at our work.
- Make agents safe to trust. Alignment on the model side, and a hard boundary around it that holds even when the model gets it wrong.

What we are looking for above all

Taste. You know what good looks like in code, in interfaces and in products, and you don't ship less. You look for the simple solution even when it takes longer to find, because clarity is worth the effort, but you also know when to take a shortcut.

An edge. At work or outside it, you have taken something further than most people ever do. We care about that far more than titles, degrees or years of experience.

Ownership. We set the direction together, and you own what you build and answer for the results. Lots of freedom, lots of responsibility, so you need to be good at directing your own work.

What we ask

- You have mastered the craft of working with language models: prompting, context, agent skills, multi-agent orchestration and compiling intent into working software, including the spells that make the difference.
- You build real software, fast, with coding agents, and you have opinions about where agentic development is going. One thing is sure: the future is not TUIs on laptops.
- A strong full-stack engineer: frontend, APIs, databases, auth and deployment (ours is mostly Go, Python, TypeScript, SolidJS, Svelte and Postgres today, but we don't hire for a stack). You take a tool from an empty repo to production on your own.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals: architecture, data modelling, clean interfaces, testing, Linux and networking. When agents write the code, fundamentals are how you judge it.
- An eye for opportunity. You have a vision. You spot what should be automated and where a product is hiding, and you find the real problem behind a request, working easily with people who are not engineers.
- Fluent English and at least working Finnish.

Any of these will make you stand out

- Security: agent sandboxing, red or blue team experience.
- Evals: designing evals that measure what matters in real work, and knowing when a good number is misleading.
- AI products: you have taken an AI-driven product or technology from idea to production, with real users or customers relying on it.
- Inference and GPU systems: SGLang or vLLM internals, speculative decoding, disaggregated serving, KV-cache offloading, low-bit quantization, kernels in Triton or CUDA, ROCm.
- Infrastructure and trust: confidential computing and attestation, bare metal, AWS or other cloud.
- Model training: post-training, preference optimization, RL, distillation, datasets, alignment and safety.
- AI hardware beyond NVIDIA: AMD, Tenstorrent, Cerebras, Etched, hardwired inference silicon, NPUs and other edge accelerators.
- Classic ML and sensing: anomaly detection, RF signal processing, biosignals (ECG, EEG), computer vision, sensor fusion.
- Mission-critical and regulated domains: defence, public safety, critical infrastructure or healthcare.

What we offer

- Interesting work, above all.
- The best tools for the job: frontier (and?) open-weights models, and our own GPUs to experiment on.
- Real influence on where Bittium takes AI.
- Work that matters for Europe's security, where reliability is not optional. Competitive pay and Bittium's employee benefits.
- Hybrid work in Oulu or Espoo.

How to apply

Enclose your CV, a link to or attachment of your best work, and a few lines about something you have taken further than most people. We will start interviewing shortlisted candidates during the application period.

Due to the nature of Bittium's business and our customers' expectations, you are a Finnish citizen and able to pass security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security Intelligence Service (SUPO)

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provide

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (Python/DevOps) - Hybrid
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Developer (Python/DevOps) -Hybrid, Stockholm

The company is a Nordic-Baltic venture studio founded in Stockholm in 2016. They work hands-on with both startups and larger enterprises to build digital products — investing in and building companies, rather than just consulting. Employees get the opportunity to invest in the portfolio companies and share in the upside if there's an exit. The culture is described as entrepreneurial and ownership-driven, with a focus on work-life balance — working close to founders and core teams where decisions are actually made, rather than off a backlog.

Are you an experienced Backend or Fullstack Developer who enjoys bridging the gap between robust code and cutting-edge tech? Do you want the unique possibility to invest in the next generation of tech startups while building large-scale solutions? Then you might be the right fit for us!

Location: Stockholm (Onsite/Hybrid)

Our Vision & Mission

Our vision is to be the ultimate partner for building the tech companies of the future. We transform innovative ideas into thriving businesses. As an employer, our goal is to provide an environment where technical excellence meets entrepreneurship, and where your personal growth drives our collective success.

Your Impact: Builder & Investor

You are more than a developer; you are a builder and an investor,

    Strategic Growth: Gain deep business acumen by working across both the startup ecosystem and the enterprise world.
    Ownership & Equity: We combine the impact of high-level consulting with the strategic upside of venture capital. Through our unique model, you gain ownership in the companies we support, becoming a shareholder in our diverse portfolio of over 35 ventures.
    The Investment Council: No matter your current project, you are always a core part of us. You’ll for example have the opportunity to join our Investment Council and help decide which companies we back next.
    AI Landscape: We encourage initiative and provide the space to turn your curiosity about AI/ML into real-world growth.

The Role: Tech & Innovation

You will join our Tech Forum, a collaborative group of experts (Fullstack, DevOps, Architects) dedicated to high-quality code and modern solutions.

    Core Backend: Design and develop scalable systems primarily in Python with frameworks such as django, flask or fastapi.
    DevOps & Infrastructure: Take ownership of CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments using GCP (preferred), AWS, Docker, and Terraform.
    Dynamic Projects: Toggle between high-stakes projects, moving seamlessly from building products from the ground up to solving complex challenges for large enterprises.

Culture & People

Our culture is built on our values: Adventurous, Caring, and Inspiring.

    Community: We are a dog-friendly office that loves spending time together through Hackathons, After Works, and communal lunches.
    Balance: We respect that everyone is in different stages of life. Your well-being and work-life balance are top priorities.
    Growth Mindset: We offer a dedicated education budget and a clear path for career progression.

Who You Are:

    Experience: 5-7 years of professional backend or fullstack development.
    Technical Stack: High proficiency in Python (e.g., Django, flask, fastapi)
    Cloud infrastructure: Preferably GCP or AWS.
    DevOps: CI/CD Pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (e.g. Terraform, Ansible), Microservices containerization (e.g. Docker/Kubernetes)
    Consultancy Mindset: You have experience working as a consultant or across various projects and thrive in the journey from Startup to Enterprise.
    Business Acumen: You are interested in the "why" behind the code and how it creates value.
    Language: Fluent in Swedish and English.

AI - No need to be an expert, but a keen interest with some experience:

    Agent-Native: You integrate AI agents and autonomous workflows as a natural part of your backend architecture and infra-stack.
    Master of Tools: You’ve moved beyond simple chats. You leverage Cursor, Copilot, and advanced agents to accelerate delivery without ever compromising on code quality.
    Scalable AI: You know how to build and grow AI features in a fullstack environment while keeping the system stable and fast.

Nice to Have:

    Frontend: Experience or interest in collaborating with our experts in React/Next.js.
    Startup Experience: Experience building products from scratch.

Ready to be more than just a developer? Apply now and help us build the next generation of successful companies, regardless of the project.

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.

Welcome to submit your application!

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Paris
jobs.description:
Get to know us

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

The role

Ideals has been in the Virtual Data Room space since 2008 and has built a trusted reputation with clients across multiple industries in Europe, including Deloitte, and EY.

To support the next stage of Ideals VDR growth in France, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive based in Paris. Joining our French Key Accounts team, you will own the full new business sales cycle and sell directly to a wide variety of enterprise corporations across diverse industries (such as energy, pharma, biotech, telecommunications, etc.).

As a quota-carrying strategic seller, your primary goal will be to grow sales and revenue through the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts and the expansion of existing ones. You will act as an impactful industry expert, generating demand, navigating complex 6 to 9-month sales cycles, and displacing incumbents by utilizing deep discovery and consultative selling frameworks.

Compensation package: 50% base salary; 50% performance-based variable.

Why Ideals?

  • Industry-leading sales culture: Ideals ranks among the Top-10% of companies on RepVue, as rated by sales professionals. You’ll be empowered with dedicated Sales Enablement, RevOps, Marketing support, and a structured onboarding ramp.

  • Stable growth: You’ll join a profitable, bootstrapped SaaS company that is positioned to deliver 5x revenue expansion and reach unicorn status in the next 5 years. The deals you close will shape Ideals' footprint in France and feed into our global scaling ambition.

  • Sales motion built on regional nuance: You’ll be part of a European-headquartered org, with over 18 years of selling in the VDR business. You'll drive GTM in the region we understand deeply, backed by a product that already powers 10%+ of global M&A activity.

What you will do

  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline focused on the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts (new logos)

  • Conduct solution-based sales engagements, including client meetings, executive presentations, and product demonstrations (face-to-face and virtual)

  • Maintain "White Space" analysis and execute strategic initiatives to upsell and cross-sell within the existing customer base

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive business cases that quantify the cost of inaction and address customer priorities, pain points, and ROI

  • Structure, negotiate, and close complex deals, guiding corporate clients step-by-step through enterprise procurement, security compliance, and legal processes

  • Orchestrate multi-threading strategies to navigate enterprise politics, establishing strong relationships with C-Suite executives and key stakeholders across various verticals

  • Keep an accurate track record of personal sales activities in the CRM, including methodical mid- and long-term forecasting

  • Provide relevant customer feedback to the product development team and collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, and Inbound Sales to maximize revenue and customer satisfaction

What you bring

  • 4–7 years of demonstrable quota-carrying success in B2B sales

  • Proven track record of managing lengthy or complex enterprise sales cycles

  • Significant experience selling directly to C-level executives (CxOs) and multi-threading within large enterprise organizations

  • Clear understanding of, and practical experience with, consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDPIC, SPIN, Challenger)

  • Exceptional business communication skills, enabling you to execute executive storytelling, challenge the status quo, and handle complex contracting negotiations

  • High learning agility, analytical thinking, and commercial curiosity to quickly grasp the nuances of various corporate industries

  • High AI fluency and advanced CRM tracking skills

  • Native-level proficiency in French with professional English level (C1+)

  • Based in Paris or within a realistic commuting distance for regular in-person client meetings

Nice to have

  • Background in SaaS, financial technology, or information security sectors

  • Familiarity with enterprise M&A use cases and corporate compliance workflows

What we offer

We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential.

For your best work

  • Remote-first flexibility to shape your ideal workday

  • Home workplace budget

  • Co-working expense coverage

  • Individual IT budget for extra equipment

  • Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools

For your growth

  • Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses

  • Investment in external learning and development activities

  • Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation

  • Professional literature and subscriptions coverage

  • Support of your passion as a speaker or writer

  • Internal talent mobility opportunities

For your well-being

  • Tailored Wellness Package to support your physical and mental health

  • Urban Sports membership

  • Funding for sports competitions

  • 25 business days of paid time off per year

  • Paid health-related time off

Extra perks

  • Budget for team gatherings

  • Generous internal referral program

Our culture

Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we create a team where talents feel at ease and work to the best of their abilities.

Discover more.

Ideals is an equal opportunity employer

Ideals is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people from all walks of life. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, or citizenship.

À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

Vos responsabilités

  • Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

  • La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

  • Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger.

  • Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

  • Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

  • Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

  • Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client

  • Vous écrivez clairement et savez expliquer des concepts complexes d'assurance à des non-experts

  • Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine

  • Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez passé des années à maîtriser l'assurance et souhaitez encoder cette expertise dans un produit qui transforme l'industrie

  • L'idée de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur vous enthousiasme, pas seulement utiliser des outils, mais les construire

  • Vous êtes méticuleux, rigoureux, et mettez un point d'honneur à bien faire les choses

  • Vous aimez accompagner les clients et les aider à réussir

  • Vous voulez rejoindre suffisamment tôt pour façonner ce que doit être le courtage assisté par IA

Ce rôle n'est pas fait pour vous si

  • Vous cherchez un poste de courtage traditionnel avec un portefeuille clients et des objectifs commerciaux

  • Vous préférez la routine à la construction from scratch

  • Les détails vous ennuient

Ce qui rend ce rôle unique

  • Vous rejoignez à un stade où le produit est suffisamment jeune pour que votre expertise façonne directement son intelligence

  • Vous vérifierez et améliorerez les outputs IA en IARD, Santé, et au-delà au fil de notre expansion

  • Vous faites partie de la boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA continuellement plus intelligente

  • Vous vivez la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur — un point de vue rare dans le secteur

  • Vous êtes un membre fondateur d'une équipe qui construit l'OS IA pour les courtiers européens. Cela signifie une vraie ownership, un vrai impact, et une trajectoire qui évolue avec Panora.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Responsabilité de niveau fondateur et impact direct sur le produit

  • Votre expertise assurance devient l'intelligence du produit

  • Une place au premier rang de la transformation IA en assurance, vue de l'intérieur

  • Courbe d'apprentissage intense à l'intersection de l'assurance et de l'IA

  • Package de rémunération compétitif, incluant des equity

  • Travaillez depuis les bureaux d'Hexa aux côtés de fondateurs, d'opérateurs et d'autres startups en early stage

Processus de recrutement

  1. Call intro avec l'équipe Talent d'Hexa (30 minutes)

  2. Call fit avec Diane pour comprendre votre parcours et votre expertise (30 minutes)

  3. Un scénario assurance réel : examiner une synthèse générée par l'IA, identifier les lacunes et expliquer comment vous amélioreriez l'output (à faire chez vous + restitution de 45 minutes avec Diane et Fabian)

  4. Une rencontre avec Fabien (CTO)

  5. Un entretien avec Matthieu, Partner chez Hexa

Panora s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés sans distinction de genre, origine, identité, parcours ou orientation sexuelle.

Nous savons qu'il reste beaucoup à faire en matière de diversité dans notre secteur, c'est pourquoi nous encourageons toutes les candidatures — en particulier celles issues de milieux sous-représentés.

jobs.description:

Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Implantée dans le monde entier, la société emploie 6100 personnes dans le monde et possède plus de 2 500 clients répartis dans 155 pays et plus de 21 500 moteurs en service.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionAs Supply Chain Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and optimising our end-to-end supply chain. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll lead strategic procurement, inventory control, and purchasing operations while overseeing Noria, Warranty, Pool, and Logistics activities that keep our production and commercial goals on track. This is a high-impact role where your ability to drive efficiency, ensure on-time delivery, and uphold quality standards will directly contribute to our success, while aligning the supply chain with the company's broader strategic vision.



Key Responsibilities

As the Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for leading and optimising key supply chain functions across inventory, logistics, procurement, and team management to support production and commercial goals. Your main responsibilities will include:



Inventory Planning & Management:

o Develop and maintain accurate inventory forecasts aligned with business needs

o Balance customer demand with inventory levels to optimise availability and minimise excess stock

o Analyse consumption patterns, seasonal trends, and market dynamics

o Manage repairable and unserviceable inventory, including buy-back processes

o Monitor inventory usage to identify obsolescence risks and recommend solutions

o Maintain stock accuracy through cycle counts, stocktakes, and proactive replenishment strategies

o Collaborate with suppliers to resolve issues, improve service levels, and support sourcing initiatives



Logistics Management:

o Oversee transportation services, including providers, freight costs, customs compliance, and export controls

o Ensure timely delivery of products and materials while optimising shipping efficiency

o Support warehousing operations, including material handling, storage, and dispatch

o Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in logistics and warehouse processes



Purchasing & Procurement:

o Maintain accurate supplier records and oversee onboarding of new vendors

o Manage requests for quotations (RFQs) and source suppliers to meet business requirements

o Maintain purchase orders and monitor subcontracted repair activities

o Evaluate vendor performance against quality, delivery, and cost standards

Export Control and Customs Compliance

o Provide support to Export Compliance Officer, Customs Compliance Officer and Empowered Official in the execution of Safran Export Control and Customs Compliance Standards.



Leadership & Team Management:

o Lead, coach, and manage the supply chain team to achieve high performance

o Manage staff qualifications, training, leave, and performance management

o Provide support to Procurement Coordinator, Warehouse Supervisor, and Noria/Warranty/Pool Coordinator

jobs.title: People & Production Manager - Material & Delivery
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead a major production organisation and play a key role in shaping the future of one of Sweden's leading manufacturing businesses? At DOVISTA, you'll have the opportunity to drive operational excellence, develop leaders and make a lasting impact in an international industrial environment.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/4aa67c38-b348-4a74-81f8-9b8225ef9e06.jpg">

Your Opportunity

We are looking for a strong people and operations manager to take responsibility for our Material & Delivery operations, a critical part of our window manufacturing business. Leading approximately 200 employees through a team of six first-line managers and two process developers, you will play a key role in driving performance, strengthening the organisation and ensuring operational excellence across the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to take responsibility for a large production area and make a significant impact on people, culture and operational performance. Whether you currently manage a production department, a manufacturing unit, or a sizeable operational team, you are motivated by driving results through others and developing strong leadership teams.

You will work closely with our Senior Director, Head of Operations Sweden, and be part of the production management team, contributing to both strategic direction and operational execution. This is a visible leadership position with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on people, performance and culture. With around 600 colleagues at our Edsbyn site, you'll join a growing team in a company that's shaping the future.

Who You Are

You have a solid background in manufacturing or industrial operations and a track record of creating results through people, structure and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking responsibility for a larger operation, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability at all levels of the organisation. Just as important, you know how to engage people, develop talent and build a culture where performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

We believe you have:

    Proven experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Experience building strong teams and creating results through others
    A track record of driving operational improvements and delivering results
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    A university degree in engineering, production, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through a successful leadership career in manufacturing.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    To be considered for this position, you must hold a permanent work permit in Sweden.

Why Edsbyn?

Choosing to live and work in Edsbyn means embracing balance. You'll find proximity to nature, space for family life, and a welcoming community - all while making a real impact in a globally connected business. For the right person, this role offers a rare combination of significant leadership responsibility, long-term career opportunities, and a high quality of life in one of Sweden's most scenic regions.

Application

This recruitment is managed in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at +46 70 377 06 64 or marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background, experience, and qualifications make you a strong fit for the role.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-10-17.  Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people's everyday lives.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

About DOVISTA Sweden

DOVISTA Sweden brings together well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds Fönster, and VELFAC with local experts within a strong international group.

With approximately 700 employees, we are one of Sweden's leading window manufacturers. Together, we develop sustainable, high-quality solutions with a focus on our customers and the future.

Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.

Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.

Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Your responsibilities
Take commercial ownership of a portfolio of existing business customers.
Develop trusted relationships with key contacts and decision-makers.
Gain a thorough understanding of each customer’s business, infrastructure requirements, and growth plans.
Recognize opportunities to introduce additional services or expand existing solutions.
Produce quotations, proposals, presentations, and supporting commercial documents.
Demonstrate our services and communicate their practical value to customers.
Negotiate pricing, contractual terms, and service conditions.
Meet agreed individual sales and revenue objectives.
Track customer satisfaction and take action when there is a risk of losing an account.
Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.
Coordinate customer matters with Technical Account Managers, Support, Billing, Sales, and engineering teams.
Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

What we expect
A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

Jak bude vypadat tvůj den?
Budeš oporou týmu obsluhy během směny a tím, kdo udává tempo i náladu. Přivítáš hosty, pomůžeš kolegům v náročnějších chvílích a postaráš se o to, aby servis fungoval hladce od prvního ranního úsměvu až po poslední večerní kávu.
Čeká tě spolupráce s kuchyní i ostatními odděleními hotelu, zaškolování nových kolegů a řešení situací, které přináší každý den v gastronomii. Zapojíš se také do organizace firemních akcí a dalších eventů.
Zkrátka práce, ve které nebudeš jen plnit úkoly, ale budeš mít možnost ovlivnit celkový zážitek našich hostů.

Koho hledáme?
Máš zkušenosti z restaurace, hotelu nebo gastronomie a umíš vést lidi příkladem.
Jsi komunikativní, samostatný/á a spolehlivý/á. Nezalekneš se rušnějšího provozu ani nečekaných situací a záleží ti na tom, aby host odjížděl spokojený.
Domluvíš se alespoň základy angličtiny a máš chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady.

Co Vám můžeme nabídnout:
-    stabilní práci na hlavní pracovní poměr

Description du poste :

Vous souhaitez manager des équipes tout en contribuant au bien-être et à la conservation des animaux dans un environnement unique ?

Le ZooParc de Beauval recherche son futur Responsable Carnivores H/F pour piloter un périmètre composé de 3 secteurs animaliers : Koalas Pandas, Fauves et Otaries , chacun encadré par un Chef de secteur.

Votre rôle sera d'accompagner les Chefs de secteur, de faire progresser les équipes, d'optimiser l'organisation et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence dans les pratiques animalières et la sécurité.

Missions principales***Piloter les équipes à travers les Chefs de secteur et les accompagner dans leur rôle Assurer le suivi des équipes, identifier les besoins d'accompagnement et favoriser la montée en compétences Créer une dynamique collective et encourager la coopération entre les différents secteurs Être présent sur le terrain et rester à l'écoute des réalités opérationnelles Garantir la qualité des soins et le bien-être des animaux, en lien avec les équipes vétérinaires Veiller à l'application des protocoles du département animalier Optimiser les pratiques, les méthodes de travail, les ressources et les plannings Accompagner les Chefs de secteur dans la recherche de solutions et d'améliorations Garantir la sécurité des équipes et des installations et veiller au respect des procédures Participer aux projets transverses liés au développement du parc.

Profil

Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en management et maîtrisez l'encadrement d'équipes dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant.

Une expérience polyvalente dans le milieu animalier est nécessaire . Votre intérêt pour les espèces animales, notamment les carnivores, sera un véritable atout.

Reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité à prendre du recul et votre sang-froid, vous savez communiquer clairement, poser un cadre et prendre les décisions nécessaires.

Rigoureux, organisé et doté d'un bon esprit d'analyse, vous aimez faire progresser vos collaborateurs et optimiser les organisations.

Vous souhaitez vous investir dans un poste à responsabilités, au cœur des enjeux liés au bien-être animal, à la sécurité et au développement du ZooParc de Beauval ? Rejoignez-nous !

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Notre offre

À votre arrivée, vous bénéficierez d'une formation, d'un accompagnement et d'un parcours d'intégration. Un pack uniforme complet , adapté à votre métier, vous sera remis.

Vous profiterez également de nombreux avantages : accompagnement au logement, covoiturage via BlaBlaCar Daily , mutuelle, CSE, billets à tarifs préférentiels, crèche et événements d'entreprise.

Nous employons le masculin uniquement pour alléger le texte. Ce poste est ouvert aux femmes et aux hommes. Le ZooParc de Beauval pratique l'équité en matière d'emploi (Index Egapro 2026 : 84/100 ).

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:

 - Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

 - Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

 - People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

 - People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

1. Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

 - Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.



2. Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.



3. Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.



4. Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.
