jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The infrastructure underneath that experience must make it straightforward to launch services, isolate workloads, and run reliable systems at scale.

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Cloud Infrastructure: the shared infrastructure as code (IaC), networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms that Replit's product and platform teams depend on. You'll lead and grow an existing engineering team building and operating these foundations, including Kubernetes, shared edge networking, service mesh and workload identity.

This is a platform-building role with production accountability. You should be comfortable going deep on a design or incident while developing a team that does not depend on you for every decision.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the cloud-platform roadmap. Lead the team's IaC, networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms. Translate product, platform, reliability, and security needs into sequenced outcomes, balancing foundational investment, lifecycle work, and delivery commitments against the team's capacity.

 - Make infrastructure repeatable and self-service. Build maintained IaC interfaces for services, cells, connectivity, identities, and shared resources. Enable internal customer teams to provision infrastructure without bespoke coordination or dependence on individual experts.

 - Operate what the team builds. Own platform availability, upgrades, isolation, recovery, and incident remediation. Maintain clear SLOs, sustainable on-call coverage, and primary and backup owners for critical systems.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated infrastructure changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, set clear expectations, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Delegate meaningful ownership as the team grows.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

 - Software-oriented infrastructure depth. You have built and operated cloud platforms or distributed systems and can reason across infrastructure code, Kubernetes, networking, service identity, and stateful dependencies.

 - Safe-change and production judgment. You have owned consequential migrations and incidents, can explain failure modes and rollback limits, and know when simplifying a system is better than adding another platform.

 - Platform-product and engineering judgment. You understand internal customers, create interfaces other teams adopt, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, developer autonomy, engineering effort, and workload efficiency.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with multi-tenant, cellular, regional, or dedicated enterprise infrastructure.

 - Familiarity with GCP/GKE, Terraform or similar IaC systems, Cloudflare, Envoy/Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and managed data services.

 - Experience with large-fleet rightsizing, infrastructure consolidation, or migrating CI compute without disrupting developer workflows.

 - A track record using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: RESPONSABLE DE SITE ITINERANT (H/F)
jobs.description:
Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F)

Un poste de terrain, au cœur de nos résidences
Vous aimez les environnements variés, les nouveaux défis et les missions qui ont du sens ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de plusieurs établissements plutôt que d'un seul ?
Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F) et devenez un véritable référent opérationnel au sein de notre réseau de 16 résidences Appart'Hôtels implantées dans la partie Est de France.

Qui sommes-nous ?
KOSY Appart'Hôtels, exploité par Habitat Gestion, c'est :
- Un réseau de 16 résidences,
- Présents dans 9 villes,
- Exploitant près de 1 400 logements en France,
- Avec plus de 25 ans d'expertise.
Implantés à Forbach, Saint-Avold, Reims, Nancy, Troyes, Mâcon, Grenoble, Aix-Les-Bains et Avignon.
Nous accueillons étudiants, professionnels et voyageurs en leur proposant des solutions d'hébergement tout confort, de la nuitée au séjour longue durée. Nos appartements, du studio au T2, sont entièrement meublés et équipés, avec Wi-Fi et de nombreux services à la carte.
Vous recherchez un poste où autonomie, diversité des missions et proximité avec la direction sont une réalité ? Rejoignez Kosy et participez au développement de notre réseau de résidences.
Pour en savoir plus : www.kosy-apparthotels.com

Votre mission :
Rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel, votre mission s'articule autour de deux axes principaux :
- Renforcer les équipes lors des pics d'activité, des rentrées universitaires, des périodes touristiques ou tout autre besoin opérationnel.
- Remplacer les responsables de résidence pendant leurs absences (congés, formations, maladie, etc.) afin de garantir le bon fonctionnement de chaque établissement.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à :
- (Co)-piloter l'exploitation quotidienne d'une résidence ;
- Garantir un accueil client de qualité et veiller à la satisfaction de nos résidents et clients ;
- Accompagner, coordonner et soutenir les équipes présentes sur site (interne ou externe) ;
- Suivre l'activité commerciale et respecter les objectifs de taux d'occupation ;
- Assurer le suivi administratif et opérationnel de l'établissement ;
- Veiller au respect des procédures, des standards qualité et des règles de sécurité ;
- Accompagner les équipes lors des périodes de forte activité et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de leurs process.

Profil souhaité :
Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement d'hébergement (résidence de services, résidence étudiante, appart'hôtel).
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
- votre autonomie ;
- votre capacité d'adaptation ;
- votre sens de l'organisation ;
- votre réactivité ;
Vous appréciez les environnements variés, savez rapidement prendre vos marques dans un nouvel établissement et aimez relever de nouveaux défis.
Ce poste implique des déplacements de 2 à 3 semaines par trimestre, principalement sur nos résidences de Reims, Mâcon, Saint-Avold et Grenoble, afin d'assurer les remplacements ou de renforcer les équipes selon les besoins de l'exploitation.
Vous êtes directement rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel.
En dehors des périodes de remplacement, le poste est rattaché au siège, à Nancy.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
- Une grande autonomie dans vos missions.
- Une forte diversité d'environnements et de rencontres.
- Une proximité immédiate avec la direction générale.
- L'opportunité de développer vos compétences sur plusieurs typologies d'établissements.
- Une entreprise à taille humaine, attachée à la proximité, à la qualité de service et à l'accompagnement de ses équipes.

Informations complémentaires
- CDI - 39h
- Statut : Agent de Maîtrise
- Convention collective de l'immobilier (IDCC 1527)
- Mutuelle d'entreprise
- Prise en charge des déplacements et hébergement par Kosy lors des missions.
- Rémunération annuelle brute : 33 000 € sur 13 mois

MISSIONS :

- Soumet à sa direction les choix d'achats de biomasse,
- A un œil vigilant sur la conformité réglementaire de l'origine de la biomasse en lien avec sa direction,
- Planifie et organise les livraisons de biomasse (hebdomadaire, mensuel, annuel) pour assurer un approvisionnement permettant le fonctionnement de la ou des centrales en production,
- Planifie, contrôle et coordonne les activités d'exploitation forestières (abattage, débardage, broyage, transport, stockage) pour les chantiers de l'équipe de mobilisation,
- Organise les opérations de stockage/déstockage sur parc de rupture le cas échéant,
- Suit les contrats en communication permanente avec la responsable de parc à bois,
- Informe le Responsable de parc en cas de difficultés d'approvisionnement ou de changement de volume livré au jour le jour pour permettre la coordination appro/réception,
- Réalise les calculs de coût de biomasse réel/ chantier,
- Programme et organise les chantiers de défriche selon une stratégie définie et validé par la direction,

jobs.title: Er du klar for et viktig samfunnsoppdrag og forvalte en stor eiendomsportefølje?
jobs.description:
Boligstiftelsen etablerte egen administrasjon som overtok forvaltningen av stiftelsen fra 2021 med daglig leder og driftssjef. I 2023 ansatte stiftelsen fire egne driftsteknikere etter at kommunen sa opp avtalen om vaktmestertjenester. 

 

Som daglig leder skal du forvalte og videreutvikle stiftelsen som en viktig samfunnsaktør i tett samarbeid med vår kunde og samarbeidspartner Ringerike kommune. Du skal videreføre det arbeidet som er igangsatt samtidig som du bidrar til å sette retning, ta tak i nye utfordringer, skape engasjement og sørge for gjennomføring av viktige prosjekter og oppgaver i samarbeid med egen organisasjon og styret.

 

Du får ansvaret for en driftsorganisasjon med høy eiendomsfaglig- og driftsmessig kompetanse.

 

Vi ser etter en leder som evner å kombinere strategisk blikk med operasjonell handlekraft og som skaper resultater sammen med andre.

 

 

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver vil være

●       Lede og videreutvikle stiftelsens arbeid

●       Sikre god økonomistyring og bærekraftig forvaltning og drift av eiendomsporteføljen

●       Videreutvikle relasjonene og samarbeidet med Ringerike Kommune

●       Utvikling – og reforhandling av avtaler

●       Styrke stiftelses omdømme som en viktig samfunnsaktør med stort samfunnsansvar

●       Videreutvikle standarder på tekniske og økonomiske områder

●       Lede ulike type prosjekter / prosjektutvikling

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi søker en trygg, tydelig og samlende leder med god økonomiforståelse, gode gjennomførings- og samarbeidsevner og som evner å sette retning for vår videre utvikling.

 

Du har erfaring fra lederstillinger med resultatansvar og kan vise til gode resultater når det gjelder utviklings- og forbedringsarbeid. Det er en fordel (behøver ikke) om du har erfaring fra eiendom, økonomi eller annen kompetanse- og tjenestebasert virksomhet. Det viktigste er at du evner å forstå vår virksomhet og se mulighetene som ligger foran oss og at du har kraft til å realisere dem i samarbeid med egen organisasjon og kunde/samarbeidspartner.

 

Høyere utdanning er ønskelig, men relevant ledererfaring kan kompensere for utdanning.

 

 

Vi håper du kjenner deg igjen i flere av disse beskrivelsene

●       Du er en tydelig, troverdig og tillitsskapende leder

●       Du evner å bygge langsiktige relasjoner internt og eksternt

●       Du kommuniserer godt med kunder, samarbeidspartnere,       medarbeidere og andre

●       Du er tålmodig og har sterk gjennomføringskraft og evner å omsette  planer til handling

●       Du trives med å utvikle organisasjoner og mennesker

●       Du trives både med strategiske og operativt oppgaver

 

 

Ønsker du nærmere informasjon om stillingen så kontakter du Temp-Team ved Glenn G. Hovde på tlf. 982 44 777 eller epost gho@temp-team.no

Alle henvendelser til Temp-Team behandles konfidensielt om ønskelig også overfor Ringerike Boligstiftelse i innledende fase.

 

Søknad med CV lastes opp via stillingsannonsen.

Søknadsfrist: Snarest og senest 21.10.2026

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ringerike boligstiftelse er en alminnelig stiftelse opprettet av Ringerike kommune og Ringerike boligbyggelag i 1970 og forvalter 650 boenheter fordelt på ca. 62 000 kvm. Stiftelsens hovedformål er å skaffe boliger til tidsbegrenset utleie å erverve eller forestå oppføring av trygdeboliger, samt boliger og institusjoner til bruk for pleie- omsorg, helse og sosialtjenesten og leie ut leiligheter i slike bygg i Ringerike kommune. Ringerike boligstiftelse har som målsetting at eiendommene skal bidra til økt livskvalitet for beboerne og økt produktivitet for de ansatte.  Vi er lokalisert på Hvervenmoen i moderne lokaler og er 6 ansatte.

jobs.title: Food & Beverage Duty Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Food & Beverage Duty Manager Contract: Full-time, permanent 40 hours per week Hours: as rostered 5 in 7 days rotating 2 days off together when possible Role Purpose Lead Duty shifts withing the hotel focusing on F&B operations to brand standards—delivering exceptional guest service, safe and efficient shifts, This role blends hands-on floor leadership with business administration responsibilities (cost control, reporting, and process improvement), ideally suited to a candidate with a Business Administration degree who enjoys applying analytical skills in a dynamic hospitality environment. Key Outcomes • Consistently high guest satisfaction across bars, restaurant, room service, and events in evening trade. • Controlled labour, waste, and COGS with accurate end-of-shift admin and timely reporting. Responsibilities 1) Duty Manager Operations Leadership • Lead pre-service briefings; set sections and upsell focus; ensure menus/allergen info are current. • Oversee floor, bar, and room-service delivery; support meeting & event service as required. • Ensure closing procedures (cash, stock, security, cleanliness) are completed and signed off. 2) People & Service • Coach, motivate and performance-manage evening teams; ensure breaks and rota compliance. • Conduct on-shift training (service steps, allergen awareness, wine/spirits, suggestive selling). 3) Finance & Administration (Business Administration Focus) • Daily P&L inputs: complete cash-up, voids/discounts rationale, revenue splits, and banking's. • Labour management: optimise evening schedules vs. forecast; track labour % daily/weekly; propose productivity improvements. • COGS control: approve transfers, spot-check yields, wastage and portioning; collaborate with stores on ordering and par levels. • Reporting & analysis: build concise dashboards (e.g., sales mix, RevPASH, average check, promo ROI) and present weekly insights with actions. • Menu engineering: analyse sales mix and contribution margins; recommend pricing, bundling, or product changes. • Process improvement: map key workflows (closing, cash control, stock), identify bottlenecks, and run small kaizen projects with measurable outcomes. • Vendor & cost reviews: support supplier comparisons, SLA tracking, and invoice query resolution. • Projects: assist F&B Manager with business cases (e.g., equipment upgrades); track benefits realisation. Essential Experience required: • 1+ years’ F&B experience in hotel or Duty Manager e • Business Administration degree or equivalent—able to apply financial/operational analysis to daily decisions. • Strong guest-recovery skills and calm, visible leadership on busy evening shifts. • Working knowledge of HACCP, allergens, licensing, cash handling, and staff rostering. • Excellent English; Spanish and Portuguese an advantage (useful with international guests and suppliers). Desirable Experience: • Experience with menu engineering, costings, or stock systems (Procure Wizard).

jobs.employer: UCC EXPERTS UNIFIED COMMUNICATION AND CO
jobs.description:
Ingénieur DevOps Cloud / Kubernetes (H/F)
1. Contexte du Poste & Enjeux à Toulouse
Expérience requise : 9 ans minimum (profil Senior / Expert).
Localisation : Toulouse et agglomération (Blagnac, Labège, etc.).

Contexte local :
Missions Principales
Architecture & Design de Plateformes Cloud : Concevoir, bâtir et faire évoluer les architectures Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP ou Cloud Souverain) et on-premise hautement disponibles, scalables et sécurisées.
Stratégie Kubernetes & Containerisation : Définir la stratégie de conteneurisation globale de l'entreprise, industrialiser le déploiement des clusters Kubernetes à grande échelle et garantir leur résilience.
Industrialisation & Automatisation (CI/CD) : Concevoir les pipelines d'intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) les plus optimisés possibles pour automatiser le cycle de vie applicatif du code à la production.
FinOps & Performance : Optimiser les coûts d'infrastructure Cloud (démarche FinOps) et veiller aux performances globales des environnements.

Leadership Technique & Culture DevOps : Porter la culture DevOps/DevSecOps au sein des équipes, évangéliser les bonnes pratiques, rédiger les standards d'architecture et mentorer les ingénieurs juniors/seniors.

3. Compétences Techniques Détaillées (Hard Skills)
A. Containerisation & Écosystème Kubernetes (Expertise Majeure)
Orchestration : Maîtrise approfondie de Kubernetes (architecture des control planes, etcd, kube-proxy, CNI, CSI). Expérience sur les managed clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE) et on-premise (Rancher, OpenShift, k3s).

Networking & Service Mesh : Configuration des CNI (Calico, Cilium, Flannel), gestion des Ingress Controllers (NGINX, Traefik) et mise en place de Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) pour la gestion du trafic inter-services.

Stockage & Stateful : Gestion des volumes persistant (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook/Ceph, NFS).

Package Management : Maîtrise de Helm pour le templating et le packaging d'applications.

B. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Providers
Cloud Publics : Maîtrise avancée d'au moins un grand Cloud provider (AWS ou Azure / GCP), ou des environnements OpenStack / VMware pour les contextes on-premise/privés.

IaC & Provisioning : Maîtrise absolue de Terraform / OpenTofu (gestion d'état, modules, remote state) et Ansible pour la configuration.

Immutable Infrastructure : Utilisation d'outils comme Packer pour la génération d'images de VM/conteneurs.

C. CI/CD & Automatisation du Software Delivery
Pipelines CI/CD : Conception de chaînes d'intégration complexes avec GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Argo CD ou Jenkins.

GitOps : Implémentation de paradigmes GitOps avec ArgoCD ou FluxCD pour synchroniser l'état des clusters Kubernetes avec les repositories Git.

D. Observabilité, Monitoring & SRE
Supervision & Métriques : Déploiement et administration de Prometheus, Thanos, Cortex, et design de dashboards sur Grafana.

Centralisation des Logs & Tracing : Maîtrise des stacks d'observabilité (ELK / EFK, Grafana Loki, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry).

Fiabilité (SRE) : Définition des SLO, SLA et SLI, gestion des alertes et automatisation de la remédiation (incident response).

E. Sécurité (DevSecOps) & Compliance
Software Supply Chain Security : Analyse de vulnérabilités des images (Trivy, Clair), signature d'images (Cosign), SBOM (Software Bill of Materials).

jobs.title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

Are you an experienced cleaning professional interested in a guiding role where you can support your teams daily work and help ensure high-quality service delivery? At N-Clean, we work responsibly as part of a reliable and supportive team.

As a Service Instructor, you will work under the supervision of your manager and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at customer sites. You will work responsibly and ensure that tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with agreed quality standards and operating practices. Acting as a key link between employees, management, and customers, you will support your supervisor in daily operations. Please note that this role does not include formal managerial responsibilities.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and success requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills. In your role, you will have a direct impact on the customer experience and the success of customer relationships. Active collaboration, clear communication, and a solution-oriented approach are essential for this position.

**Your responsibilities include**

- Ensuring the quality and smooth execution of daily cleaning operations, planning work allocation, and utilizing resources cost-effectively

- Continuously developing operations together with your supervisor and actively contributing improvement ideas

- Guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- Collaborating with customers

- Regular participation in practical cleaning work


**What we expect from you**

- Ability to guide and support colleagues in daily situations, promote an inclusive and respectful work environment, and provide clear feedback

- Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach

- A customer-focused working style and positive attitude

- Ability to work under pressure and solve problems effectively

- Communication skills in Finnish or English, both spoken and written. Language skills are important in this guiding role to ensure clear communication, understanding of work instructions, safe working practices, and management of employment-related matters. If one language is fluent, the other can be at a basic working level. We value a diverse workplace where different languages and cultural backgrounds are seen as strengths.

- If you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit

- A valid driver's license and the possibility to use your own car, as the working area is extensive and the role requires travel between sites

- Previous experience in cleaning services. Knowledge of commercial cleaning and cleaning industry qualifications are considered an advantage


**What we offer**

- A permanent full-time employment contract, 37.5 hours per week

- Shifts on weekdays and weekends, including early morning, morning, daytime, and evening shifts

- Start date to be agreed upon separately

- Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- Fair employment terms, a safe working environment, and support for employee well-being

- Competitive salary in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Property Services Employees, €2,235/month

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and respectfully and do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to maintaining a safe and well-being-focused workplace.

jobs.title: POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
jobs.description:
POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
The University of Helsinki, Department of Chemistry, invites applications for a postdoctoral or doctoral researcher position in photocatalytic radical chemistry at the newly established Lahdenperä Group. Initially, the position is fixed-term for 12-months with a possibility of an extension.
Position description
The successful candidate will join an organic chemistry research group at the Department of Chemistry located at Kumpula campus. The research group aims to develop new concepts for controlling radical reactivity in photocatalytic transformations. The project focuses on the development of new approaches for controlling radical reactivity through hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) at surfaces and interfaces.
The project will involve:
* Development and optimisation of photocatalytic radical transformations
* Mechanistic studies of radical reactions and detailed investigation of HAT processes.
* Surface functionalization and interface chemistry.
* Design and synthesis of organic molecules.

The postdoctoral researcher will additionally be expected to contribute to the supervision of students and participate in future funding applications.
Requirements
Postdoctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a PhD degree in chemistry or a closely related field by the start of employment, or be close to completion of their doctoral studies.
Consideration will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
* synthetic organic chemistry.
* photocatalysis, radical chemistry, hydrogen atom transfer processes.
* reaction mechanism studies.
* flow chemistry.

The successful candidate should demonstrate the ability to conduct independent research and publish scientific results in international peer-reviewed journals.
Doctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in chemistry or a closely related discipline that qualifies them for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki.
Previous experience in organic synthesis, photochemistry, catalysis or related experimental chemistry is advantageous but not required.
Selected candidates for the interview process will be required to provide a copy of their university transcript before interview date.
For both positions
We are looking for candidates who are:
* highly motivated and scientifically curious.
* willing to develop new experimental skills.
* persistent and independent in tackling challenging research questions.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
Salary and benefits
The salary follows the salary system of University salary system and is based on the researcher's qualifications, experience, and stage of doctoral or postdoctoral career.
For postdoctoral researchers, the starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
For doctoral researcher the starting salary will be approximately 2600–2800 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* Curriculum vitae, including a publication list (if applicable).
* A concise motivation letter describing your research interests, relevant experience, reasons for applying and career plans. Please indicate your desired starting date in the application.
* Degree certificate (PhD for postdoctoral applicants; Master's degree for doctoral researcher applicants).

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
The deadline for applications is October 16th, 2026.
Ideally, the selected candidate will start as soon as possible, although flexibility in the starting date can be arranged. Regardless, candidates who are unable to start immediately are still encouraged to apply. The selected applicants will be given support to apply for available grants or fellowships.
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until a suitable candidate is found. Interviews may start before closing date 16.10.2026.
Additional information
Further information about the position can be obtained from Dr. Antti Lahdenperä, antti.sk.lahdenpera@helsinki.fi.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja – Helsinki ja Espoo
jobs.description:
**Services Netto Oy** hakee itsenäisiä, huolellisia ja luotettavia kotisiivoojia Helsingin ja Espoon alueelle. Työ sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy itsenäisessä ja liikkuvassa työssä sekä haluaa vaikuttaa omiin työvuoroihinsa.

**Työtehtävät**

Kotisiivoojana työskentelet asiakkaidemme kodeissa ja huolehdit niiden siisteydestä ja viihtyvyydestä. Kokeneemmille työntekijöille voimme tarjota myös erikoissiivoustehtäviä, kuten raivaussiivouksia. Työtehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa:

- imurointi ja lattioiden pesu

- pölyjen ja pintojen pyyhintä

- keittiön siivous

- kylpyhuoneen ja WC-tilojen siivous

- muut asiakkaan kanssa sovitut kodin siivoustehtävät.


Työ on liikkuvaa kotisiivoustyötä, ja työpäivän aikana siirryt asiakkaalta toiselle. Kuljetat työssä tarvittavat siivousvälineet ja -tarvikkeet mukanasi repussa asiakaskohteesta toiseen.

- oma-aloitteista ja itsenäistä työotetta

- asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä

- perussiivouksen hallintaa

Aikaisempi kokemus kotisiivouksesta tai muista siivoustehtävistä katsotaan eduksi. Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus ovat myös eduksi, mutta eivät välttämättömiä.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääasiassa arkipäiville, eikä työ sisällä viikonlopputyötä. Voit vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi ja työskennellä osa-aikaisesti tai keikkaluonteisesti omaan elämäntilanteeseesi sopivalla tavalla.

Kerro hakemuksessasi aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi, käytettävyydestäsi sekä siitä, kuinka monta tuntia viikossa olet kiinnostunut työskentelemään.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 5 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
jobs.description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with (#Ericsson) mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance
Interested?

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

More information arja.martikainen@barona.fi

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics
jobs.description:
About the position

A 4-year position as PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics is available at the Natural History Museum (NHM), University of Oslo. The 4-year fellowship includes 25% career-enhancing work, such as curation, teaching, supervision, research support and public outreach.

The project is supervised by Dr. Andrew Foote (NHM).
The PhD project will reconstruct the colonisation of high latitudes by North Atlantic killer whales (Orcinus orca), to better understand how populations responded to past climatic warming at the Pleistocene–Holocene transition. Range expansions and demographic change leave signatures in the genome, including changes in genetic diversity and in how genetic variation is distributed within and among populations. These signatures are not uniform along the genome, but depend on local genomic parameters such as mutation and recombination rate.

The candidate will quantify changes in genetic diversity and variation through time, and investigate how these patterns vary across the genome. The project will combine an existing dataset of approximately 200 contemporary genomes with a new time series of ancient killer whale genomes generated within the project. The tasks will include ancient DNA laboratory work, bioinformatic processing of Next Generation Sequencing data, and population genomic analyses, including demographic inference.
The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The selected candidate will be enrolled in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Within two months of commencing the position, the candidate must submit a PhD agreement, including a plan for the required doctoral courses and a project description. For more information about the programme, see: http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/   


Qualifications / Requirments 

You must have:
•    An MSc degree in evolutionary biology, population genetics, bioinformatics, or a related field.
•    Research experience in population genetics or population genomics.
•    Experience with bioinformatic analysis of Next Generation Sequencing data, including command-line work in a high-performance computing environment.
•    Programming or scripting skills (e.g., R, Python, bash).
•    Excellent written and verbal communication ability in English. English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8 

Desirable qualifications (in ranked order):
•    Experience with ancient DNA laboratory work.
•    Experience with demographic inference, coalescent methods, or population genetic simulations.
•    Strong interest in evolutionary responses to past climate change

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows, according to the Norwegian educational system:
•    The average grade for courses included in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The average grade for courses included in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The Master's thesis must have grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
See: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7 

The evaluation of applicants will focus on the following:
•    Relevance and quality of the MSc thesis
•    Relevance and quality of scientific publications (not necessarily expected at this level)
•    Grades at relevant university-level courses (population genetics, evolutionary biology, bioinformatics, statistics, programming, wet-lab molecular techniques)
•    The fit of the applicant's career plan, interests, and skills as formulated in the cover letter (see How to apply below)
•    Personal suitability (incl. collaborative skills) and motivation for the position
•    An interview, including a 15 minute presentation of your MSc thesis (only short-listed candidates)


What are we looking for in you?

•    Honesty and high standards for scientific integrity
•    Ability to give and receive scientific criticism in a constructive manner
•    A positive attitude and drive for learning skills, methods and theory
•    Ability to work in a structured manner, facilitating teamwork
•    Ability to prioritise and complete work tasks
•    Ability to work independently, as well as collaboratively in an international and interdisciplinary research environment
•    Careful and well-documented approach to laboratory and computational work

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


How to apply

The application must include (as separate and numbered documents):

1.    Cover letter with a statement of motivation and research interests
2.    CV summarizing education, positions and academic work, scientific publications, and other relevant experience
3.    Statement explaining how a PhD in population genomics will fit into the applicant’s career plan (max 1 page)
4.    Copies of educational certificates and transcripts of records (as a single PDF)
5.    Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
6.    Names and contact details of 2-3 references (i.e., name, affiliation, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number). The references will be contacted if necessary. Letters of recommendation are therefore not required.

jobs.title: Passionate about brewing and eager to learn and grow together with us?
jobs.description:
FLO continues to expand, new opportunities are constantly emerging across the company. For the right person, this role can be the beginning of an exciting career with us. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your technical skills, take on more responsibility and potentially move into other roles as the company grows. Based at our production facility in the countryside outside Oslo, you’ll become part of an ambitious and hands-on production team where quality, craftsmanship and continuous improvement are at the heart of what we do.

 

The role

Reporting to our Head of Production, you’ll be involved throughout the brewing and production process – from brewing and quality control to carbonation, filtration and kegging. Your key responsibilities will include:

 

  • Brewing Operations: Execute brewing processes according to recipes and established procedures, ensuring excellent quality and consistency in every batch.
  • Quality Control: Perform quality testing using equipment such as the Anton Paar Alcolyzer, pH meters, Dissolved Oxygen meters and CO₂ measurement devices.
  • Carbonation: Manage and fine-tune beverage carbonation to achieve the desired specifications.
  • Kegging & Filtration: Operate kegging and filtration equipment, ensuring our products meet the highest standards.
  • Cleaning & Sanitation: Carry out thorough Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) procedures for tanks, hoses, carbonation units, pumps, the brewhouse and other production equipment in accordance with our SOPs.
  • Production Data: Accurately record and update production and quality data in our ERP systems Odoo.
  • Packaging Support: Support packaging operations when required and work closely with colleagues across production.

You’ll also play an active role in keeping our workplace clean, safe, organized and efficient – and we want you to contribute ideas. We believe the people closest to production are often the ones who see the best opportunities for improvement.

 

Who are you? You’re someone who takes pride in your work and cares about the details that make the difference between a good product and a great one. Ideally, you have formal education in brewing, beverage production, food science or a related field, combined with some practical experience from a brewery or similar production environment. However, we’re also interested in people with the right technical understanding, attitude and desire to learn. We think you’ll thrive at FLO if you: 
 

  • Have a genuine interest in brewing and beverage production
  • Have relevant education and preferably some practical brewing or production experience
  • Are technically minded, practical and comfortable working hands-on
  • Understand the importance of hygiene, accuracy and consistency
  • Take ownership and responsibility for your work
  • Enjoy working as part of a team
  • Are curious and always looking for ways to improve
  • Want to continue learning and developing professionally
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-moving company where things evolve as we grow

Why FLO?

FLO AS is an ambitious company with exciting plans for the future. We are investing in our growth, our production and, importantly, our people. Joining us now means becoming part of that journey. For the right person, there will be significant opportunities to learn, develop and progress within the company. As FLO grows, new positions and responsibilities continue to emerge, creating opportunities for internal promotion and career development. 

 

You’ll be joining a company you can build a career with. Our production facility is located in a rural area outside Oslo. Due to the location, having access to a car is strongly recommended. Candidates must already have the legal right to live and work in Norway. Applicants residing within the EU/EEA who are eligible to work in Norway are welcome to apply.

 

If you want to learn, develop and be part of building something exciting, we’d love to hear from you: Whether you already have brewing experience or are early in your professional brewing career, this could be your opportunity to take the next step. We’re looking for someone who wants to master the craft, contribute to the team and develop alongside a company with big ambitions. Add Persona is managing the recruitment process on behalf of FLO AS. If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are warmly welcome to get in touch with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

 

Come brew with FLO – and be part of what we’re building.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

FLO is a leading company in beverage development and production, known for our innovative approach, high quality standards, and strong customer partnerships. As a dedicated co-packer, we produce private-label beverages for customers in Norway, across the Nordic region, and in international markets, as well as manufacturing products for other brand owners.

 

FLO operates from modern, high-quality facilities at Sollihøgda. Today, we are a team of 29 employees with diverse professional backgrounds, united by a shared drive: to create together, deliver quality, and have fun along the way. We value diversity, continuous development, and a start-up mindset built on the belief that nothing is impossible. At FLO, success is not only about the results we achieve, but also about how we achieve them – as a team that supports, challenges, and celebrates together.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Kuopion alueelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Kuopion alueelle. Aloitus on mahdollisimman pian, joten toivomme hakemustasi pikaisesti.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


**Edellytämme sinulta**

- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti

jobs.title: Office Coordinator (part-time), Nordic Semiconductor Finland, Tampere
jobs.description:
About the role

In this part-time role, you will be the heart of our Tampere office, ensuring a welcoming environment for employees and guests. Working closely with our Oulu-based support team, you will manage daily logistics, coordinate fun social events, and keep our workspace organized.

You are offered a highly flexible part-time schedule (40-50%, about 2 days a week) that can be distributed across the week to fit your lifestyle. Enjoy a respectful, stress-free work environment where work-life balance is truly prioritized.

Work tasks
- Coordinate daily office operations and maintain a welcoming, tidy environment
- Organize office social events, staff gatherings, and traditional "fika" moments
- Prepare meeting rooms, including catering, cleanliness, and checking AV/IT equipment
- Manage office supplies, general procurement, and incoming/outgoing deliveries
- Welcome visitors and provide general front-desk support
- Act as the main point of contact for facility maintenance, cleaning, and equipment vendors

We are looking for

- A proactive, empathetic, and highly organized approach to work
- Fluent English skills and at least B-level (good) Finnish skills
- Experience in service-minded roles such as retail, hospitality, or customer service
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools

It is meritorious if you have
- Basic knowledge of AI tools and Canva
- Norwegian and/or Swedish language skills

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process. To join us in a part-time role, youll need another main activity that covers at least 50% of your time. That could be studies, another job, running your own business, parental leave, or something similar.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Model Capabilities
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has been at the cutting edge of AI since before ChatGPT launched. The job of the Model Capabilities team is to keep us there. We own the model layer of Notion AI: integrating frontier models as they ship, keeping inference reliable and economical at scale, and building new capabilities that other teams take advantage of.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Bring new frontier models into production quickly, making them available for our users and our engineers.

 - Make inference reliable: better error categorization, self-healing retries, and cross-provider failover.

 - Own observability for the model layer, driving down both time to detection and time to fix.

 - Build new model-level capabilities and help product teams adopt them.

 - Act as connective tissue across Notion's AI teams: find the gaps, unblock people, and make sure fixes land with the right owner.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Comfort with a moving frontier: The model landscape changes monthly. You keep up with it, form your own view of what's real, and stay pragmatic about what's worth adopting now.

 - AI fluency as a practitioner: You use AI tools seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

 - Production AI systems experience: You've built and operated systems on top of LLM APIs, not just prototyped with them. You understand token economics, streaming, tool calling, context limits, and how each of these fails in production.

 - Measurement before conviction: You don't ship a prompt or model change on vibes. You define what "better" means, build or use the evaluation to test it, and are willing to be proven wrong by your own data.

 - Cost and performance instincts: You treat latency and dollars as product qualities, not afterthoughts, and you can reason about the tradeoff between them and output quality.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 – $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Senior PM Consultant – Fund Migration (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior PM Consultant – Fund Migration

We are looking for a Senior Fund Migration Consultant with a strong track record of delivering complex fund migration programmes end to end, from initial scoping through to post-migration stabilisation, across the full spectrum of asset servicing functions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end delivery of complex fund migration programmes, covering initial scoping, planning, execution, conversion, operational readiness, and post-migration stabilisation.
• Act as the primary project contact for clients, fund management companies, custodians, transfer agents, administrators, portfolio managers, brokers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, decision-making, and escalation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Define and maintain detailed project plans, migration roadmaps, wave plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, runbooks, stakeholder maps, governance materials, and status reporting dashboards.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams across fund administration, transfer agency, custody, middle office, fund accounting, client service, legal, compliance, technology, and operations to deliver against agreed scope, time, cost, and quality objectives.
• Oversee key migration activities including data readiness, data validation, file delivery, reconciliation, operating model design, service model changes, testing, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.
• Chair working groups, steering committees, and governance forums, providing concise updates, recommendations, and decision papers to senior stakeholders.
• Identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues relating to data quality, system functionality, resource availability, client dependencies, regulatory constraints, and project scope.
• Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across migration methodology, documentation, controls, and reusable delivery frameworks.
• Support Client Service Delivery Managers in identifying service model impacts and ensuring changes are captured appropriately in service level agreements and handover documentation.

Requirements

• 5 to 10 years of consulting or project delivery experience within financial services, asset servicing, fund administration, or investment management.
• Demonstrable track record of delivering large and complex fund migration programmes as a consultant, including administrator transitions, fund conversions, launches, mergers, or liquidations.
• Strong understanding of investment funds and asset servicing operating models: fund administration, transfer agency, custody, middle office, fund accounting, and client service processes.
• Proven experience managing migration plans, conversion events, data validation, reconciliations, testing, cutover readiness, and post-implementation stabilisation.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, challenge, and build trusted relationships with senior clients, internal partners, and external service providers.
• Strong governance discipline, including experience preparing executive-level status reporting, steering committee materials, RAID logs, project plans, runbooks, and decision papers.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, competing priorities, and dependencies while maintaining delivery discipline and attention to detail under pressure.
• Fluent in English, mandatory; French and/or German would be an important advantage.
• Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, or equivalent) is a valued plus.

• Plan and manage corporate tax liabilities and VAT payments;
• Supervise the Procurement function covering third party service provider management, risk management, due diligence, contracts, and DORA compliance for ICT service providers;
• Ensure timely and error-free production and submission of all applicable regulatory and Group reports;
• Maintain accuracy and completeness of data in all reports, ensuring conformance to regulatory templates and Group expectations;
• Maintain process-driven, auditable, controlled, scalable and automated reporting procedures;
• Manage process documentation including Policies, Procedures, guidelines, and manuals;
• Lead and develop teams of experienced professionals across finance and regulatory reporting functions;
• Support Authorized Management and the Board of Directors on all financial accounting and regulatory reporting matters;
• Participate in new Project implementations and in the adaptation of the organization to evolving regulatory requirements and Nomura Group operating structure;
• Coordinate with the Bank's IT function on system enhancements and new Projects from a financial perspective;
• Manage external and internal audits of the in-scope functions and processes.

Job requirements:

• BAC+4/5 in Accounting or related field;
• Minimum 10 years demonstrable robust experience in a relevant senior Financial Accounting/Audit role in the Banking sector in Luxembourg/Europe with tangible exposure to regulatory reporting;
• Proven experience in managing multi-functional teams;
• Strong analytical skills with focus on accuracy and deadline adherence;

• Fluent in English (French considered an advantage);
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools;
• Knowledge of Olympic Banking system considered as a strong advantage;

Regulatory Compliance Analyst
Compliance - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International

Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role – Are you ready for a challenge?

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

Regulatory Watch Management

• Daily active monitoring of regulatory changes through the websites of the local authorities -specifically regarding topics such as Conflict of Interest, Inducements, Gift & Hospitality and Whistleblowing, in jurisdictions where Utmost Luxembourg distributes its products, to ensure timely identification and implementation;
• Regular exchange with other in-house experts and stakeholders of the Group on other regulatory topics monitored by them related to topics such as Distribution, AI rules, CAA Investment rules… to ensure they are also covered by the process owned by the team, registered in the systems and so timely identified, assessed and implemented;
• Maintenance of the internal tool to track regulations of relevance since their identification until their implementation;
• Preparation of the meetings with experts/stakeholders and ExCo members, every two months or every quarter, respectively;
• Drafting the minutes of the bi-monthly/quarterly meetings.

Regulatory Compliance Monitoring Activity

• Contribute to the annual update of the Compliance Risk Assessment with the Business and follow-up of actions identified to mitigate the risk exposure of the compliance risk impacted, when needed;
• Support the annual execution of the Compliance Monitoring Plan, on the core topics, including reporting, debriefing of the testing and remediation follow-up of actions identified to address gaps, when needed;
• Support thematic reviews on emerging areas or higher risk topics, selected on annual basis, to prevent "compliance blind spots";
• Support oversight compliance monitoring on the Branches of Utmost Luxembourg;
• Participate in the maintenance of the local Registers (ex: CoI Register, Inducements Register and G&H Register).

Regulatory Compliance Framework

• Contribute to the annual update of the local Compliance Charter, Policies, Procedures and Guidelines related to Regulatory Compliance matters;
• Contribute to the annual update of training material related to Regulatory Compliance matters;
• Supervise the collection of the management information data in terms of KRIs and the regular compliance reporting to the senior management reporting on monthly and quarterly basis.

Your profile - Have you got what it takes to become our Regulatory Compliance Specialist?

• 5+ years of experience in a Compliance, Risk or Audit Function, related to the Regulatory Compliance matters within the Life Insurance sector;
• Knowledge of the Luxembourg rules and regulations or of another EU member state impacting the Life Insurance sector;
• Ability to balance legal requirements with the commercial aspects of the business;
• Excellent analytical skills with a high degree of initiative, attention to details, planning and organisational skills;
• Strong communication, presentation and influencing skills, with ability to express opinion to internal and external customers;
• Enthusiastic team player and self-motivated;
• Able to cope with pressure and tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment;
• Fluent in English; knowledge of other languages will be considered an asset.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
